subject: UPDATE: On Bogus CFB Attack
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_complaint_attack&n=1)
---
Peter \-- The gauntlet has been thrown down! I have an important update on the Establishment's legal hellfire missile attack on us. I told you about the the bogus Campaign Finance Board (CFB) complaint early this month. Their strike into our base has landed too close for us not to fight back with everything we have. They've penetrated our perimeter and it's legal hand-to-hand combat now. As mentioned when I broke the news the other week, this is a political hit on us by the Political Class. Even worse, it's not from the Democrats. Its from the Republican Establishment. As President Trump eventually learned, the enemies are on both sides of the aisle. **In fact, the lawyer behind the complaint against us is a lawyer hired by the Republican Party of Minnesota.** The enemy is behind our front lines. You'd think in this critical election year, you would want to have the largest grassroots, conservative group on your side. But that's not the case. They even went after Republican endorsed liberty candidates who are fighting for our mission to preserve liberty by cutting off their Data Center access from the Republican Party. The Political Class will do anything they can to destroy Patriots like you and me. They do NOT want this grassroots, conservative movement rising up and challenging their power structure. In my previous email about them attacking us, I let you know I needed to get back to my Board of Directors to hatch out the battleplan. And we set an initial goal to raise $30,000 for this legal war. **I have some major updates on those fronts:**
1. **Today our lawyer threw down the gauntlet about the CFB's abuse of power and authority. Telling the CFB "YOU HAVE NO AUTHORITY" to continue with this witch hunt.**********
2. **Strong supporters have pledged HUGE MATCHING DONATIONS!!!**

But the best update is that Action 4 Liberty supporters like you have stepped up big by contributing to our call for help. Remember, the Political Class is swimming in money. Just look at their finance reports. They're not funded by grassroots conservatives like us. They get their funding by Big Corporations, the Wealthy Elite, Special Interests and Lobbyists.
## This is what we're up against!
This means we are reliant on good, hard-working American Patriots like yourself to keep operations going to hold these people accountable. We fought the State Fair, Facebook and have even had the FBI called on us AND WON - every time. You see, Action 4 Liberty - with your help - is willing to go all the way to the Supreme Court if needed to push back on these government attacks on what you and I have built. Which brings us to the next stage of this battle. I need your help. We MUST teach these guys a lesson that we're unified in our effort to hold the Political Class accountable. Remember, the CFB rejected the staff attorney's legal recommendation and instead took the political retribution track. **With that in mind, major supporter have pledged to match up to $15,000 in donations.** That's right. $15,000 matching. What that means is for every $50 you contribute to this battle, it's actually $100.
# IT DOUBLES YOUR IMPACT!!
You all made a big initial push at the start of the month. Thank you! With Patriots like you having my back, my Board of Directors and I instructed our attorneys to prepare for a massive legal fight. I'm confident YOU will be here shoulder-to-shoulder, but my Board of Directors needs reassurances by month's end. **So it's more critical now than before to chip in ANYTHING you can to help fight back and WIN!** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_complaint_attack&n=2 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_complaint_attack&n=2)
---
This is too important of a mission to fail.
# **_THE GOAL UPDATE_**
I'm happy to report that Action 4 Liberty supporters have had our back so far!
We **already raised $7,245** for the legal fund.
So after the matching, $15,000, if we can raise just another $7,755, we'll hit our $30,000 goal right away!
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_complaint_attack&n=3)
You're donation will instantly be worth twice the amount thanks to the very generous match.
Can you chip in what you did at the beginning of the month?
If you didn't before, can you please chip in now?
**_Please help me out. I need you to pitch in to our legal fund RIGHT NOW to keep Action 4 Liberty going and NOT let the Political Class win on this one._**
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_complaint_attack&n=4 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_complaint_attack&n=4)
---
Action 4 Liberty supporters like you have really stepped up in these moments. Whether it's during Walz' illegal lockdowns against our business owners or bogus CFB complaints, we have a large network of patriots willing to have our backs!
We have a BIG TARGET on our backs because we challenge the Political Class. But that won't stop us from holding them accountable.
And because the consequences of inaction are so severe, we MUST fight like a junkyard dog.
I'm not kidding here...if we don't prevail, this empowers the Political Class tremendously. If they can take us down, they can take anyone down.
**Action 4 Liberty's mission is to protect liberty for the next generation. We've grown in size and influence in Minnesota. But if this all goes away, the liberty movement is back at Square One.**
That can't happen!
I really need your help here. We have the opportunity to send a message to the Political Class that Action 4 Liberty supporters have our back.
If we fail, they'll be like sharks in the water that smell blood.
With you having my back, we can win.
[**Please help me today with a donation to our Legal Fund. Your donation will instantly be worth double because of very generous matches by a couple donors. Please donate what you can to get us to our $30,000 goal**](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bogus_cfb_complaint_attack&n=5).
**In Liberty,**
****
**Jake Duesenberg**
**President, Action 4 Liberty**
Action 4 Liberty
1920 Oakcrest Ave #5
Roseville, MN 55113
Action 4 Liberty · United States

name: Travis Bull Johnson for Congress
subject: My stance on issues related to agriculture 🚜
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Travis "Bull" Johnson for Congress Committee_
body:
|
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | |
---
**My Stance on Issues Related to Agrigulture** In my district, farm policies are, for good reason, of great concern to voters. As a farmer and rancher myself, I am confident that my positions will resonate with the farming community here in Minnesota. As a matter of fact, I’m running under the only party whose main platform is centered around agriculture.
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
---
| **Stop the War on Ag.** There are some in congress, primarily from the progressive wing, who have labeled farming and feeding the world as a danger to the climate. They push agendas and restrictions that farmers, and particularly smaller farmers, cannot adhere to causing them to lose their farms, leaving only large corporate farms. ****Stop the War on Energy. ****Educating the urban population is key. Farming is run primarily on diesel, fertilizer comes from natural gas, our crops are dried with propane, and hog barns are heated by gas. Inflating the prices on energy greatly reduces a farmer’s ability to feed the world. Electric farm equipment is expensive and not currently suitable for our needs. Stopping to charge a battery is _not_ sustainable. ****Free Trade**. **President Trump used the U.S.’s position of “#1 importer in the world” as leverage to force acceptance and importation of all our agriculture products. No country calling itself our ally or trading partner should ever reject our corn, soy, or beef. Free trade means free trade. ****Legalize Hemp. ****I'm in talks with the University of Minnesota Crookston staff to create a feed research study for this high yield, drought resistant, low fertilizer product that could be our feed and fiber product of the future. ****Increase Markets and Profits. ****Reductions in USDA rules would allow for farm-to-table local sales and increased opportunities, especially for those raising livestock. With more and more processors using corporate owned animals the free-market for smaller livestock farmers is almost non-existent. Reduction in USDA rules would also give consumers more leverage to ensure they are getting the best product for the money. Many of us are aware of people who had to slaughter animals during COVID when processors shut down. Current regulations prevented local consumers from simply purchasing this meat, as opposed to wasting it. USDA reforms are required to encourage diversification of food processors and ensure food security, especially during major disasters. I am a “producers first” advocate. We need processors who are able to serve _all_ , including local communities and smaller farmers. ****Population and Diversity. ****I believe that less government is better government. So, when should the government intervene? To increase markets, increasingly making a place for smaller, or specialty farms. We need a more diverse ag economy to support resilient vendor and co-op communities. I raise belted Galloway cattle, goats, and pasture raised hogs. While not the future of BIG ag, I have a market, as so many other small farmers. Diversity needs to be encouraged. Family farms have been shrinking. The giant processors and commodity giants can’t be our only voice in DC. ****Waters of the USA.**** Smaller government is good government. There will never be Waters of the USA if you want my vote on any ag or environmental bill. This is a gross overreach of the Federal Government. As a supporter of property rights I firmly believe that _your_ land is _your_ land. Nobody should force you to plant “carbon capture” crops, or limit your options, and profit. My loyalty lies with farmers and constituents of this district. If I had two calls waiting, one from ADM and the other from Lyon County Corn & Soy Growers, ADM will have to wait. The Farm Bill is the most important piece of legislation in the world. What comes of it is a deciding factor in whether or not we can make a living. I sat down with Collin Peterson to better understand the farm bill and will continue to seek out his assistance, and others along the way, while _always_ listening to my constituents. Travis "Bull" Johnson

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I’m building a campaign that reaches out to voters in every corner of the
state. But to do that, we have to hit our goals. That is why we’ve set a
goal to raise $1 million online before July 31 – 100 days out from
Election Day.

I wanted to share with you a story about why I’m committed to running a
campaign that lifts up all Georgians. [ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220728_B3_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=1202%2E1862389%2EYPJR3w ]I hope you will read it, and then
make your first
donation before our July 31 deadline to ensure we reach our $1 million
goal before our fundraising deadline on Sunday.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220728_B3_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=1202%2E1862389%2EYPJR3w ]DONATE

My mother was in third grade when she dropped out of her segregated public
elementary school with no plans to return. A next door neighbor understood
how poverty made this seem like the only choice. Instead, over and over,
she encouraged my mom to go back to school.

When my mother gathered up the courage to return to school, she expected
to repeat the third grade. But when she arrived, she learned that when she
dropped out, one of her teachers wrote a letter to the principal:

“If Carolyn Hall ever comes back to school, move her on to the next grade.
She’s smart enough."

Guidance and care from a neighbor, grace and faith from a public school
teacher. That’s what worked. My mom went into the fourth grade, and when
she became the first in her family to finish high school, she graduated as
valedictorian. Eventually, she watched her own daughter also graduate as
valedictorian from DeKalb County Public Schools.

That’s the power of a community that cares. Our power and strength as
Americans live in our willingness to lift one another up.

Because we do not succeed alone.

In this country, when times are tough, we can persevere because our
friends and neighbors will come for us. Our first responders will come for
us. It is this mantra, this uncommon grace of community that has driven me
to become an attorney, a small-business owner, an author and the
Democratic nominee for governor of Georgia.

And while my name may be on the ballot, this election is not about me.

This campaign is about the people of Georgia, who have had to spend too
many years with barriers and stumbling blocks between them and the
opportunities they deserve.

From now until November, this campaign will have many twists and turns,
but one thing will remain constant: I am running for governor to create a
stronger Georgia and will work for all Georgians. But I cannot succeed
alone, Derek.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220728_B3_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=1202%2E1862389%2EYPJR3w ]That’s why I’m asking: can I count on you to make your
first donation to
power our campaign before our July 31 deadline? We have to raise $1
million online to enter the last 100 days of our campaign strong.

Let’s get it done,

Stacey

clean_body: [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor Derek, I’m building a campaign that reaches out to voters in every corner of the state. But to do that, we have to hit our goals. That is why we’ve set a goal to raise $1 million online before July 31 – 100 days out from Election Day. I wanted to share with you a story about why I’m committed to running a campaign that lifts up all Georgians. [ ]I hope you will read it, and then make your first donation before our July 31 deadline to ensure we reach our $1 million goal before our fundraising deadline on Sunday. [ ]DONATE My mother was in third grade when she dropped out of her segregated public elementary school with no plans to return. A next door neighbor understood how poverty made this seem like the only choice. Instead, over and over, she encouraged my mom to go back to school. When my mother gathered up the courage to return to school, she expected to repeat the third grade. But when she arrived, she learned that when she dropped out, one of her teachers wrote a letter to the principal: “If Carolyn Hall ever comes back to school, move her on to the next grade. She’s smart enough." Guidance and care from a neighbor, grace and faith from a public school teacher. That’s what worked. My mom went into the fourth grade, and when she became the first in her family to finish high school, she graduated as valedictorian. Eventually, she watched her own daughter also graduate as valedictorian from DeKalb County Public Schools. That’s the power of a community that cares. Our power and strength as Americans live in our willingness to lift one another up. Because we do not succeed alone. In this country, when times are tough, we can persevere because our friends and neighbors will come for us. Our first responders will come for us. It is this mantra, this uncommon grace of community that has driven me to become an attorney, a small-business owner, an author and the Democratic nominee for governor of Georgia. And while my name may be on the ballot, this election is not about me. This campaign is about the people of Georgia, who have had to spend too many years with barriers and stumbling blocks between them and the opportunities they deserve. From now until November, this campaign will have many twists and turns, but one thing will remain constant: I am running for governor to create a stronger Georgia and will work for all Georgians. But I cannot succeed alone, Derek. [ ]That’s why I’m asking: can I count on you to make your first donation to power our campaign before our July 31 deadline? We have to raise $1 million online to enter the last 100 days of our campaign strong. body:
I know that together we can do this.
#
Hi, it's Cecile.
On Tuesday, the U.S. Supreme Court cleared the way for Greg Abbott’s extreme trigger law to go into effect. **That means that on August 25th, abortion will be illegal in Texas with no exception for rape or incest.**
My mother would be horrified to know that a right all Texans had when she was governor has been eliminated by Greg Abbott and others who are only focused on control and power.

A woman’s right to make her own decisions about her body is fundamental to everything else. But that right is under attack across the country.

subject: Eastern Kentucky floods
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

I woke up to devastating photos and videos of flooding overnight in
Eastern Kentucky. We are praying for our loved ones in the path of the
flood and we will do all we can to help.

The floodwaters are devastating in Eastern Kentucky, and it is going to
get worse over the next few days. And while first responders are leading
emergency efforts on the ground in Eastern Kentucky right now, these
floods will impact our loved ones for months.

I have directed my team to work with local partners to support in any way
we can. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18436?t=1001&akid=2284%2E346206%2Eqwflxj ]Join our efforts by signing up here.

And if you are able, please consider supporting local relief efforts by
[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18432?t=1002&akid=2284%2E346206%2Eqwflxj ]donating here.

There are multiple resources available for folks in Eastern Kentucky
affected by the flooding that [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18433?t=1003&akid=2284%2E346206%2Eqwflxj ]you can find or share here. Our team will
update this list when we know of more shelters or other resources.

To our family in Eastern Kentucky: we're here for you. Please stay safe
and heed National Weather Service warnings. We will get through this
together.

Charles

It’s official, Friend.... Joe Biden and Democrats’ priorities have resulted in one of the worst economic periods in recent memory. Yet the Biden administration is more focused on redefining the word “recession” than fixing their own disastrous economic policies that [**two-thirds**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=FdiVn_m8AUH4Vi_wAfLkohoKJGvVUHi5Z7n-PvkC1HPEjKG9Eey0a7eS2AmJkMnS&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=recession_1&n=4) of Americans oppose. * U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.

With November fast approaching, I’m hoping you can double your most generous gift.

_Friend, I’m incredibly grateful to you for your continued support._
No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden’s big government.
For Florida,
Ron DeSantis

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: I'm here to lead
body:
**[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64962%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XBHw%2ffG9WrXftsCZPIqf4w&sysid=1)**

Friend,
I’m truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn’t be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I’m taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden’s Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data ..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left’s destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left’s draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I’m glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**
**Every business has a right to operate.**
That’s why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. [_**Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64963%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2b%2brX8HVrjBkyuz1KPr2SfQ&sysid=1)
I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.
I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. _**I fought back.**_
It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don’t cower with fear about what the media may say -- _I just lead_.
In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida’s 46th Governor, I didn’t let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.
I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:
✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.
✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child’s needs.
✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.
✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.
Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.
**Over my first three years, I’ve continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
[_**Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!**_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64964%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fNAtuurDglbCC92hfRdixA&sysid=1)
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.
I certainly don’t set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley’s CEOs, Big Tech’s shady algorithms, or the corrupt media’s agenda!
I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.
**I was elected to lead, not to follow.**
As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.
I’m proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as _the freest state in the country._
Yet rather than celebrate our economy, our school children being freed of compulsory masking, and the influx of overtaxed Americans who are voting with their feet to move to Florida, I am being attacked by my Democrat opponents.
I know you understand that coordinated attacks and vitriol against a successful conservative Republican like me is business as usual from the lockdown Democrats. It’s pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments.
**As Governor of Florida, I’ll never stop defending the pro-liberty, pro-free market policies that make Florida the beachhead of freedom for the nation.**
My re-election campaign sent SHOCK WAVES through the Democrat media complex when we announced a $5 MILLION ad reservation targeting Hispanic voters.
With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.
**I’m going to battle for every vote.**
As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor!
We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight.
Now, with just months to go until Election Day, I’m asking you to stand with me again by making another generous contribution to my campaign today.
With November fast approaching, I’m hoping you can double your most generous gift.
[**[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW]**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64975%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=P54oC7vgOhmQPF4ud7KF3g&sysid=1)
Regardless of the amount, I simply must have your continued support to be ready to respond to the next round of distortions and lies my Biden-loving opponents hurl at me.
_Friend, I’m incredibly grateful to you for your continued support._
No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden’s big government.
For Florida,
Ron DeSantis
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64962%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XBHw%2ffG9WrXftsCZPIqf4w&sysid=1 "DONATE
NOW") [DONATE NOW](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64976%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DN4U4EDcySUAf4p1p8x1Vg&sysid=1)

Dear
Friend,
Over the
last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided
the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of
political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen
a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and
against capitalism.

But do
they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and
capitalism?

This is
precisely why we put together this brand new eBook, The History
Of Socialism And Capitalism, from Hoover Institution senior
fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.

This
eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in
conjunction with The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and
Free-Market Capitalism. This project provides objective and
scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and
hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the
various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and
well-being.

I think
you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely,
given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US
historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political
leaders.

Simply
click here to request your free copy of The History Of Socialism
And Capitalism.

Thanks,
Greg

Greg
Stamps | Online Development
Hoover
Institution | Stanford University

With its
eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the
Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research
organization that seeks to improve the human condition by
advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national
security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred
years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have
produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

"Inside the GOP Freakout Over JD Vance’s Senate Campaign"
| **Inside the GOP Freakout Over JD Vance's Senate Campaign

"Republicans are increasingly concerned that the author-turned-MAGA crusader is 'running the worst campaign you can possibly run'"** Team,

After new polls show Tim Ryan ahead in Ohio's Senate race, Republicans are worried JD Vance is **"running the worst campaign that you could possibly run"** and saying they **"can't find JD Vance with a search warrant.”**

body:
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat lots of fruits, veggies, and whole grains to stay healthy.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many of the so-called “health foods” in our diets actually contain a harmful toxin that could be expanding your waistline.
“This nasty toxin can rip tiny tears throughout your entire gut lining,” says Dr. Gundry. “This then allows harmful bacteria and waste products to seep into your bloodstream and wreak havoc on your body.”
**Today, new research shows this common affliction is currently affecting millions of people nationwide. The common warning signs include fatigue, digestive discomfort, weight gain, brain fog, achy joints, tired muscles, and sometimes even skin problems.**
“These common health problems are often mistaken as normal signs of getting older,” explains Dr. Gundry. “But I can assure you, the harm caused by this little-known toxin is far from normal.”
The good news is, this problem can easily be fixed at home.
“It’s very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which foods contain this hidden toxin,” explains Dr. Gundry.
By simply eliminating this toxin, he has seen thousands of his own patients achieve remarkable turnarounds. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself and has kept the weight off ever since.)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release a short video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you and your loved ones should avoid.
“Our health is our greatest gift,” he explains. “So if this video helps people look better and feel better, I’m thrilled to be of service.”
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been encouraging, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.

That’s why she reached out to us and that’s why we’re suing the Spreckels Union School District and the teachers responsible for this egregious violation.

body:
**Interview with Vedat Gashi, Candidate for Congress**
PUBLISHED: THURSDAY, 28 JULY 2022 - JOANNE WALLENSTEIN

|
Westchester County Legislator Vedat Gashi is running for the Democratic nomination to represent Congressional District #16 against incumbent Jamaal Bowman and fellow member of the Board of Legislators Catherine Parker from Rye. The primary will be held on August 23, 2022 and here is what you need to know to vote. **Learn more about Gashi here:**
---|---

_**Please introduce yourself to our readers and tell us something about your background, your family and professional and political careers to date.**_

My name is Vedat Gashi and I am running to bring real results and real progress to the families of Westchester and the Bronx. When I was four years old, I came to the U.S. as a refugee when my parents fled an oppressive regime in Kosovo. I was raised in the Bronx and attended public schools. Although my parents only had a middle school education, they worked very hard, succeeded and taught us that we can do anything.
My campaign is focused on ensuring that everyone has a shot at the American dream regardless of their zip code, income or status. This country offered me a chance to succeed, which is why I am committed to providing working families a true path to the middle class and beyond.

Currently, I serve as a Westchester County legislator. Since taking office in 2020, my office has:

-Passed a first in the nation gun safety law
-Protected women's right to seek vital health care by passing a clinic access bill
-Delivered millions for childcare and affordable housing
-Supported small businesses impacted by COVID-19

_**What persuaded you to make a bid for the seat?**_

Our nation is at a crossroads and we need representatives that will safeguard our rights, protect our democratic values and create innovative policy solutions to get people back to work and propel our economy forward.

As a refugee from a country without a democracy, it pains me to see our leaders and Democrats fighting each other instead of working together to get things done. As a county legislator, I've always delivered and worked with others to get results - putting people and the everyday issues, not partisan politics or ideology.

_**What is your view on the redistricting of the Congressional map and the change in primary date? How did that affect your decision to run, and what impact might it have on the outcome?**_

The district lines have changed, but my reason for running has not. The new redistricting maps simply presented an opportunity for our grassroots campaign to thrive. We are focused on bringing our country together to deliver actual progress for everyday New Yorkers.

_**Do you currently live in the district?**_

Redistricting has created a situation where a number of candidates across the area have found themselves outside the district they were previously running in. I was raised in the Bronx, currently live in Yorktown and work in the district at the Board of Legislators offices in White Plains. After the election, I will move into the district. Meanwhile, I look forward to continuing my dialogue with residents of the district to learn more about their concerns and share my vision of how we can strengthen our country and create a fairer nation that works for everyone.
Given that Bowman is the incumbent and has received many endorsements from organizations and unions, do you think it will be possible to unseat him?

During this campaign I've met with a wide variety of supporters, and we've picked up many important endorsements. As of date, we've raised over $800,000, maintained a cash-on-hand advantage against the competition and are on track for an even stronger fund-raising total by the end of this quarter. This district deserves a representative who supports President Biden's agenda, will put progress before posturing and will work hard to get things done.

_**How do you distinguish your platform from Bowman 's? and from Parker's?**_

This is not the time to debate ideology or for performative politics. We are living in unprecedented times and I am a commonsense democrat who will roll up their sleeves on day one to protect abortion rights, marriage equality, access to affordable health care, quality public schools and equitable housing.

Specifically, I will work to codify Roe v. Wade to ensure reproductive care is protected under the law as a fundamental right; support legislation that normalizes relations between Israel and a number of Arab nations; and collaborate with the federal government to expand funding for infrastructure. I strongly object to the incumbent's votes against the Abraham Accords and his support for Congresswoman's Tlaib's Nakba resolution that calls the creation of the state of Israel a "catastrophe."

_**What achievements are you most proud of during your term of service on the Westchester County Board of Legislators?**_

I've actively served my constituents across Westchester as county legislator by lowering taxes, improving infrastructure, securing gasoline tax relief, supporting the Reproductive Health Care Facilities Access Act, approving a measure to combat gender and race-based workplace pay inequality and combating gun violence by requiring warning labels to be posted wherever firearms are sold.

_**What do you hope to do in Congress to benefit Westchester residents? Is there any chance of reinstating our SALT deductions?**_

As the Chair of Appropriations at the Board of Legislators, I've built support for expanding services while cutting taxes, and in Congress, I'll do the same. I'm focused on making real progress on the kitchen table issues like holding down taxes, lowering health care costs, strengthening our infrastructure, and improving our economy. The elimination of SALT has had a strong punitive economic impact on residents of the district and in congress I will fight to restore it.

_**With a polarized Congress and a divided country, give us your views on how the two sides can reach consensus to pass legislation on climate change, gun control, voting rights and women 's rights?**_

I'm all for reaching across the aisle for bipartisan consensus whenever realistically possible. That being said, I think the best chance to move the aforementioned legislation forward is for Democrats to maintain their majority in the House and increase their majority in the Senate, which I am working hard to achieve during these midterm elections.

_**Anything else you would like to add is welcome.**_

As someone who came to this country as a refugee, I know firsthand the importance of strengthening international relationships with our allies. As a young attorney, I returned to Kosovo to help draft foundational legal documents and establish Kosovo's Ministry of Local Government Administration. I also served as the Chief Legal Advisor to Kosovo's Prime Minister. Therefore, I find it troubling that the incumbent has actively tried to weaken the U.S. relationship with one of our most important allies in the world.

body:

> PRESS RELEASE
Vikram for N.H. is the First Republican U.S. Senate Campaign to Launch a T.V. Ad Buy
---
CONCORD, NH - July 29, 2022 - In the race for the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate, businessman and political outsider, Vikram Mansharamani, is the first primary candidate to launch a television ad buy. Buoyed by the campaign's strong donor fundraising, the ad hit the airwaves yesterday.
The Lincoln resident is shown in the 30-second spot - entitled "Businessman, Not a Politician" \- asserting his unique and varied qualifications to be New Hampshire's next Senator. This buy only serves to emphasize why key N.H. political analysts have claimed this race to be a [jump ball](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wDIEpT8yaCZ0sPF5aqeCiP5cfAb_h0OeGY1TQe6G_ZsOHRyRRnUo6wyzQ6H-GybJliagoTC4I8Z_GYHL64RKzr0SMhuMzMCQgK13ADIQKvP8E8oMoIiJfETIzzaysVcHXS0akR9kKXwDBv9n_Y2reHuN26RgYnwUy94hJEgqhCZx70_zBfATOD_KkHnsKbLLaKVhZdmL3jUqTDpaX4jwWS-Oy8p4eSKU&c=0dFHbpzMiUut4IqZ5lv5-BhUNFkUAubh4MIGemfdmg7KLGpVELow4A==&ch=NUzNS2-EVKetpeGx7-DqiPztpQKvGomGPwl1g71186HofyiMM9zv2w==).
"I am not a career politician and I haven't spent my life looking for some office for which to run. I am a businessman and I have spent my career in the real world helping entrepreneurs and Fortune 500 companies create jobs."
"I am not running because I want a fancy title or position; I am running because I want to do something for New Hampshire," said Mansharamani. "My campaign is picking up support all across the Granite State because the voters of New Hampshire agree that the career politicians have destroyed our economy and only a businessman can fix it."
The text of the ad follows:
Politicians care more about being someone then doing something...not me.
I'm a first-generation American. The son of two working-class immigrants. I pumped gas at my dad's station and flipped burgers.
Got scholarships to Yale and MIT. Wrote a book about economics. Earned my CDL to learn about trucking. Traveled the world, saw the threat posed by China. Some magazine even said something nice about me! [GRAPHIC - Worth: 100 Most Powerful People in Global Finance]
I'm a businessman, not a politician.
"And you have a lovely wife and kids too." - Kristen Mansharamani
I'm Vikram Mansharamani and I approve this message, because I'm not worried about being someone, I want to do something for the people of New Hampshire.
See the video here:

Fellow
American,

We knew
it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled
us... but we didn't see this one coming.

A few
weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the
company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team
here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated
our account, effective immediately.

Sure
enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email.

For weeks
afterwards, our team scrambled. We're a company spread across
multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless
to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in
whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded.

But why
would they do such a thing?

By now,
I'm sure you have a good guess.

It
probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of
woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, The
New York Times, Snopes, and the many other companies that have
attacked us, they simply can't abide satire that dares to mock
their left-wing orthodoxy.

So they
orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly
could.

We've
been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are
more coming - which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving
friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a
paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.

Become a
Subscriber Today >>

now, we've been building our support base in an effort to become
"cancel-proof" - so that radical companies like Front can't pull
the rug out from under us like this.

We've
come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still
vulnerable.

You can
help with your subscription today. And remember - you won't just
be standing with the Bee; you'll be standing up for free speech
of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can
try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always
win out.

If you're
familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers
to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored,
shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing
operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the
woke just can't take a joke.

As a
matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for
the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical
post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as
our "Man of the Year."

But
thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms
better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like

today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence,
now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation.

Our goal

Friend --

**By striking down _Roe v. Wade_ , the conservatives on the U.S. Supreme Court signaled their intent to give extreme Republican state legislatures significantly more power over fundamental rights to privacy.** And in an upcoming case -- _Caster v. Merrill_ \-- the Court’s conservatives could allow state legislatures to adopt maps that dilute the voting power of voters of color.

That means Republican state legislators could roll back even more fundamental rights -- and their own constituents might not be able to stop them.

_Caster v. Merrill_ is part of a decades-long campaign by conservatives to roll back the landmark Voting Rights Act (VRA). During my presidency, the Court’s conservatives chipped away at the VRA’s requirements for states with a history of discriminatory voting practices. In this latest case, they could do something similar nationwide.

[**The through-line here is clear: Conservatives on the Supreme Court are looking to roll back hard-won rights by declaring that those rights can be subject to the whims of gerrymandered state legislatures. They did it by overturning _Roe_ , and they may do it again by further undermining the Voting Rights Act. body:
I’m ready to get to Congress to fight for our common good, but I can’t do that without you.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48488924/358445939/-454070568?refcode=em_fr_2022.07.29_b1_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTNiOTJiYS01MjBmLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uul1qf2OsOdrLoBZcB3WPnKe_AE6T8_y0bJATzgMZ3U=) Hi Derek,

Yesterday, my team reached out to tell you about our [**$7,500 fundraising gap, and why we’re counting on you to help us close it.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48488925/358445940/-454070568?refcode=em_fr_2022.07.29_b1_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTNiOTJiYS01MjBmLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uul1qf2OsOdrLoBZcB3WPnKe_AE6T8_y0bJATzgMZ3U=) I wanted to take a moment to share with you why hitting this goal is so important to me and to our mission of defeating right-wing extremism in western Pennsylvania.

I got involved in this race because I believe in fighting for our common good, but what does that mean? **To me, common good means putting people first.**

It means having a government that builds the best infrastructure in the world, and having our union brothers and sisters building it. It means protecting the right to an abortion before we have right-wing legislatures banning it and putting people in prison. It means never again sending young Americans off to unnecessary wars. It means taking on the unchecked corporate power that’s killed our communities, hurt workers, and crushed small businesses. It means protecting the union way of life so that every worker in our region can form a union freely, with no more union-busting.

Last week was a good one in the U.S. Senate.
On Wednesday we passed the Chips and Science Act, which will result in major investments in cutting-edge technologies like AI, quantum computing, and advanced clean energy technologies. It's going to bring home the manufacturing of critical semiconductor chips, lower costs for consumers, and fuel scientific innovation and jobs.
I worked on several key provisions in the bill and, while it didn’t get a lot of attention, this is a key step in sharpening America's edge in the global economy — especially important as many of our competitors have taken big leaps forward.
Other news was the HUGE breakthrough this week on our plan to turbocharge the deployment of clean energy so we can confront the climate emergency and lower costs for Americans. As then-VP Biden liked to say, this is a Big #x$*!%g Deal — it will not only help achieve a 40% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030, it also provides Medicare the power to negotiate lower drug prices for Americans, extends premium support payments under the Affordable Care Act, and much more. This week's agreement was huge, but we still have a fight on our hands to get to the finish line!
As we approach this Sunday's 100 DAY mark before the November 8 election, the events of this week are a stark reminder of what having just one more vote in the U.S. Senate can mean for real progress. Think about how much we can accomplish if we can keep a Democratic majority in the House and expand our Democratic majority in the Senate 100 days from now.
We need to keep on fighting and make every one of those 100 days count!
All my best,
Chris

body:
| Hi friend, it's John Fetterman. I hope you’ve been having a safe + fun summer with your friends + loved ones. Though our summer is costing a *lot* more than it did last year, the Fetterman Fam is having a great summer right here in Braddock, PA. 😎 Dr. Oz, on the other hand, can’t say the same. I mean, he spent the 4th of July partying it up at a gala in New York, surrounded by celebrities like Ryan Seacrest and Kendall Jenner. I dare this dude to stay in Pennsylvania for like, one day. 🙄 It’s an icky reminder that ultra-rich GOP Dr. Oz doesn't even have to worry about raising money for his campaign. He’s already self-funding his campaign, plus he has essentially unlimited access to other celebrities + millionaires. Meanwhile, all summer long, we see a massive slowdown in online fundraising, since our donors (aka real people like you, friend) are rightfully spending time outside in the sun with loved ones. Don’t get me wrong. Our campaign is PROUDLY bought + paid for by the people, and we’d never have it any other way. **But with the stakes this high, I can’t afford to fall behind Dr. Oz in PA. subject: These sleazy, insulting attacks on women working to protect abortion care are what we’ve come to expect from Rep. Matt Gaetz. Let’s surprise him by proving that Americans will stand up for a woman’s right to decide whether it’s a good time to become a mother.
body:
Tell Matt Gaetz that you support abortion care
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, what’s wrong with Rep. Matt Gaetz, anyway? **_“Although your intentions were hateful, your public shaming of my appearance has done nothing but benefit me.”_** Those were the words of the incredibly brave Olivia Julianna in response to attacks on her and other pro-choice women by alleged sex traficker, Rep. Matt Gaetz of Florida.
If you sat down to construct the most awful human being you could, combined the seven deadly sins and every bad quality we know to exist, you'd be left with Matt Gaetz. Gaetz, who as we said is being actively investigated by the Justice Department for sex trafficking, shocked nobody when he was one of 20 Republican House members to vote against re-authorizing an anti-sex trafficking law. **Ever the sniveling cretin, Gaetz also got up at a right-wing conference and said, "Why is it that women with the least likelihood of getting pregnant are the ones most worried about having abortions." The crowd for his oh so witty remark--11 yr old boys in locker rooms--were not there to respond. ** **But Julianna was. ** **This courageous 19 year old abortion rights activist in Miami, Fl, was having none of that. In what can only be called an inspiring response--after reminding him he's an "alleged pedophile" and a "small man,"\--[she went ahead and raised $460,000 for ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ted0f359c-3a45-4438-bc97-408fb76f7d8b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[_Gen Z For Choice Abortion Fund_ , an organization that splits funds between the 50 states to ensure as many women as possible, who can't afford it or life in red states that have banned their basic rights, don't lose their right to choose. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T965b36f6-9d67-4bf0-af9b-ba8dcccd472b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**
---
|

---
| Well, as much as Gaetz repelled us, Julianna inspired us too. It is acts of heroism and defiance like this, by 19 year olds no less, that will be the reason we defeat these aspiring fascists and the regressive policies they support. [**So will you join me in honor of Julianna, women across the country, and, as a big middle finger to Matt Gaetz, in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Gen Z For Change, so we can help women across the country continue to control of their lives?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T344a0d1a-68c7-472e-811e-e2e8cd4a9d5b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you as always for all you do to fight for equality in our country. Sincerely,

name: Christina Cammon
subject: I want to tell you about my mom
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Now I'm no pundit, but I think that Washington could use more people like my mom.
| | |
---
Hi Peter, it's Christina, Trudy's daughter. I'm sure you're busy, but it'd mean so much to me if you could take a minute to read this email.
Watching your mom run for Senate is an experience unlike any other, and it's one I never thought I'd have.**Make no mistake, my mom is a natural leader and finds her purpose in serving others, but she's never been someone with political ambitions.** Her focus has always been on her family and her community.
**But, Peter, the moment that she stepped on the stage to announce her campaign, I knew:_My mom was built for this._**
She's spent her entire life serving her community and loved ones, starting at the tender age of 13, when she volunteered at a local hospital as a candy striper. That experience sparked a lifelong passion for nursing, and she followed her dream to serve the St. Louis community as a registered nurse. She's continued her service as a children's advocate and a volunteer for vulnerable kids. Along the way she found time to be the best mom that I could have ever asked for.
And when the COVID-19 pandemic was devastating our community, she volunteered to vaccinate Missourians, administering hundreds of shots. **Even during that terrifying, uncertain time, my mom stepped up to serve with a can-do attitude and not a whisper of fanfare, because that's just who she is, Peter.**
When her family, her community, or her country needs her, my mom answers the call. She'll put in the hard work to make things better and care for people. She lives for service, not the limelight.
**Now I'm no pundit, but I think that Washington could use more people like my mom.[If you agree with me, can you make a donation to support my mom's campaign? HER Time is supporting amazing women across the country. Women who refuse to sit by as the far-right tries to drag our country back into the 1700's. **We HAVE to think big. We HAVE to stand up together and _fight_ for our reproductive freedom, our environment, and our working families.**

Peter,

body:
We've got a gap to close.
#

Friends -
Have you ever received an email from a political campaign asking you to make a donation and all you could think was, _"What difference does it make?"_
I know the feeling. But I'm here to tell you that is never the case with our campaign, and it's not the case with this email. It makes all the difference in the world.
Let me explain why:
On Sunday night, we close the books on our July fundraising numbers. This marks the FINAL monthly deadline before our August 23 primary — before ballots are cast, counted, and a winner is declared.
What we raise between now and then will have a _huge_ impact on the kind of investments we can make in the final weeks of this race: How many ads we can run, the number of staff we can hire, and how many people are going to hear Alessandra's message for bold progressive change.
We're not taking a cent of corporate PAC money, so it's the response of supporters like you to emails like this that makes all the difference. And right now, we're pacing behind the number of contributions we need to reach our goal before Sunday.

body:
After denying a 10-year-old’s rape, it’s clear AG Yost isn’t fit for office.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48501561/358480833/1795945253?refcode=EM_FR_220729Crossman_JCSplit_SB_90DO_6_NG_TESTA_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMjA4N2UzOC02NDBmLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jFVqYzYxlAC0VFoN7nAxL5Pt1WyIayfYvl0BONoJ6F4=) I have an important race here in Ohio that I need you to be aware of, Peter.

State Representative Jeff Crossman is running for Ohio Attorney General against current AG Dave Yost. Here’s why this race requires your attention:
1. As soon as the Supreme Court struck down _Roe,_ **Yost immediately imposed Ohio’s six-week abortion ban** without any exceptions for rape or incest, despite a majority of Ohioans’ opposition.
2. When national stories detailed the horrific impact the ban had on rape victims, like a 10-year-old Ohioan girl forced to leave the state to receive abortion care, Yost lied and said the story wasn't true instead of seeking justice for this child victim.

I'm sure your inbox is filled with emails right now, but **this isn't the typical kind of fundraising message you might expect, so I hope you'll keep reading. What I'm about to tell you is why I decided to run, and it's important. **
When I'm in the middle of make-or-break moments for my Senate race like this deadline, my mind often goes back to Jacksonville – back to the tiny house I grew up in with six brothers and sisters. Things weren't always easy. Mom was a maid, Dad was a janitor, and although we didn't have a lot of money, we had each other.
In fact, it was Mom who used to say to me: "Never grow tired of doing good, Val." This inspired me to get into public service, and ever since, growing tired of doing what's right has never been an option. From my time as a social worker, a police chief and a representative in Congress, I've held this mantra close to my heart.
**_Never tire, _I remind myself, as experts say my race in Florida is one of Democrats' best opportunities to protect and expand our Senate majority.**

**_Never tire_ , I repeat, as polls show me statistically tied with my extremist opponent.

_Never tire_ , I say, ****as I head into yet another midnight fundraising deadline thousands****of dollars behind where I need to be.**
The fact of the matter is that a 50-50 Senate isn't working for you or our country. So my promise to you is this: **I will _never tire_ in this work to expand our majority and secure a future for voting rights, reproductive freedom and all our shared values.**

# Senate GOP stabs veterans in the heart, lungs and back
---
| Veterans groups fumed at the Capitol yesterday when the long-anticipated passage of a comprehensive bill to address toxic exposure in the military failed to get the 60 votes necessary to overcome the filibuster, effectively killing legislation decades in the making.

The bill’s demise came as a shock to many as activists were at the Capitol planning to _celebrate_ the passage of the bill sometime this week.

Advocates for reform on toxic exposure have been working for years to even get what was seen as a “compromise” health package that would help the VA meet the needs of the more than 200,000 veterans who were already waiting on the Airborne Toxins and Burn Pits Registry two years ago.

Since then, the list has grown substantially, nearing 300,000 today, and many of those who were on that list two years ago have already died.

The funding would have given the VA money to hire more doctors, more specialists, open new clinics and treatment centers, new hospitals, include more experimental and developing treatments, cover a wider range of ailments, and significantly improve the quality of care the VA provides.

The passage of this bill would have represented a major milestone in how veterans access care for service-acquired diseases, which have plagued military personnel for as long as war has existed.

>From the Wounded Warriors Project:
“It’s not just burn pits causing these illnesses and injuries – some who have fallen ill have reported being exposed to chemicals found in fire-fighting fluids, depleted uranium shells, engine fumes, and more. For those seeking treatment for these illnesses and toxic exposure sustained during their military service, the largest barrier for utilizing VA health systems is establishing a service-connected disability.”

We would expect the VA to care for veterans who had been shot in combat, or were injured by an IED, or suffered amputations or any other physical ailment as a result of serving our country.

But we don’t properly treat a range of health issues resulting from service that aren’t as visible, including airborne toxins, carcinogenic fumes, PTSD, anxiety/depression, and TBIs.

Agent Orange – one of many carcinogenic herbicides we sprayed over Vietnam – has killed or maimed more than 400,000 US veterans _that we know of. _One of those veterans was my father-in-law, who served in Vietnam when he was 19, and died 40 years later within months of his diagnosis.

The United States government settled with about 50,000 of those fully-disabled vets or their surviving spouses between 1984-1997, paying a whopping $3,800 each. Total. Sum.

The _monthly _benefit for losing a limb in combat is more than that.

Our nation has not fulfilled its promises to our Veterans, and while measures have been taken to slowly address health issues caused by a war from 50 years, those exposed to toxic substances post-9/11 are still waiting for help.

Disabled American Veterans emphasizes just how important this package for veterans would be:

“The Comprehensive and Overdue Support for Troops (COST) of War Act of 2021 is sweeping legislation that would provide generations of veterans suffering from several sources of toxic exposures—not just burn pits— with benefits and VA healthcare. The bill would rightly recognize the federal government’s role and responsibility to provide health care and disability compensation to veterans suffering the impacts of their toxic exposure. Additionally, the bill would establish processes to establish new presumptive conditions for exposed veterans.

The Honoring our Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics (PACT) Act of 2021 (H.R. 3967) is comprehensive legislation that would similarly provide healthcare for millions of veterans exposed to airborne hazards and burn puts. However, it would also establish presumption of service connection for 23 ailments, including respiratory diseases and cancers, related to burn pits. The bill would also create a presumption of exposure to radiation.”

The PACT Act was named after Heath Robinson, a sergeant with the Ohio National Guard who was deployed to Kosovo and Iraq. He died in 2020 from lung cancer attributed to burn pit exposure.

Open-air burn pits were common at U.S. military bases during the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan. Dangerous materials, from electronics and vehicles to human waste, were regularly doused in jet fuel and set ablaze, spewing toxic fumes and carcinogens into the air.

Many others have developed cancers, respiratory illnesses and other serious conditions as a direct result of exposure to toxins, veteran groups say.

President Joe Biden, who has championed the PACT Act, said he believes his late son Beau Biden’s brain cancer was linked to exposure to burn pits while he was deployed in Iraq in 2008.

But the Senate – who voted 84-12 on an almost identical version of the PACT Act less than a month ago – suddenly and without explanation flipped and killed the legislation in what was supposed to be the reconciliation of bills _already passed by the House and Senate._

Only _eight_ Republicans carried their yay vote over from last month’s roll call. And because doing the right thing is applauded as an act of courage these days, here's the list of people who DID THE RIGHT THING:
Every single Democrat in the Senate, plus
Boozman (R-AR)
Capito (R-WV)
Collins (R-ME)
Graham (R-SC)
Grassley (R-IA)
Hoeven (R-ND)
King (I-ME)
Moran (R-KS)
Rubio (R-FL)
Sanders (I-VT)

Here are the 41 Republicans who voted NO on treating veterans for service-acquired diseases:
Barrasso (R-WY)
Blackburn (R-TN)
Blunt (R-MO)
Braun (R-IN)
Burr (R-NC)

Inhofe (R-OK)
Johnson (R-WI)
Kennedy (R-LA)
Lankford (R-OK)
Lee (R-UT)
Lummis (R-WY)
Marshall (R-KS)
McConnell (R-KY)
Paul (R-KY)
Portman (R-OH)
Risch (R-ID)
Romney (R-UT)
Rounds (R-SD)
Sasse (R-NE)
Scott (R-FL)
Scott (R-SC)
Shelby (R-AL)
Sullivan (R-AK)
Thune (R-SD)
Tillis (R-NC)
Toomey (R-PA)
Tuberville (R-AL)
Wicker (R-MS)
Young (R-IN)

As the congressional district the highest number of veterans per capita, who has seen first-hand what this kind of exposure can do to soldiers _and _the massive VA failure in accepting responsibility in the past, I want to know _why_ Senate Republicans killed a bipartisan effort to staff our clinics, provide emerging technology that will allow us to detect diseases and save lives, and to force hundreds of thousands of veterans to keep waiting for care that may not come before they die.

The partisan toxicity and hatred on issues that should be simple, easy, and universally supported ferments disgust toward Congress and its failures to do what it was meant to do – serve the people.

We need leaders who don’t care who proposes the legislation, or which party backs it, or whose name is on it – if it needs to be done, get it done and get out of the way. Keep moving through the list of issues that are piling up that we can’t resolve because Washington runs on a points system with two camps always trying to outscore the other.

Stop playing for teams and start working for us.

And as for Florida Senator Rick Scott, who led the effort in the Senate to flip the vote and kill the PACT Act.... We’ll see you in two years, buddy.

| **We’ve seen it time and time again. These are just click bait emails.

We can’t let Dr. Oz anywhere near this U.S. Senate seat, no matter how much money he dumps into PA.
Hitting our (real) grassroots fundraising goals critical to defeating Dr. Oz + flipping this seat from 🔴 to 🔵.

Friend, I’m proud to support Brenda Siegel to be Vermont’s next Governor.
Brenda is a leader who is in touch with the needs of us all. Many Vermonters are plagued by lack of access to housing, education, and health care. They long for relief and assistance. I have no doubt that Brenda will deliver for them.
Brenda Siegel has shown that she’s the right leader for Vermont. She understands what we must do to move Vermont forward.
Her steadfast commitment to addressing vital issues including the housing shortage, fighting the overdose crisis, which is personal to her, and supporting and strengthening our education system makes her the ideal candidate to advocate for those in need.

body:

[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6293%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=A0rfPvqxIkklpMtbE8wHow&sysid=1)

| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.
---
| | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64913%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2y1NE0PofTkU9cSuvgnv8Q&sysid=1)

body:
| | | |
---
| | | Patriots,

Below are some exciting updates on our various state freedom caucuses. Please consider [donating](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=90e141ad4a&e=64ecec6d03) so that they can continue to fight for you and your family!
---
|
---
| **ARIZONA** Last week, we helped launch the Arizona Freedom Caucus. “Buckle in, Arizona!” - that’s what a liberal columnist [wrote](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=3c8bb05080&e=64ecec6d03) in the state’s top liberal newspaper in response to our launch. The political establishment is justifiably worried that we’ll build on the success that our freedom caucus members have already had - greatly restricting abortion, expanding school choice to EVERY child in the state, and passing strong election integrity laws.
AZFC Chairman Jake Hoffman said the following about how the AZFC will vote as a bloc on “non-negotiable” issues.

“In those situations, yes, we will hold the line,” he said. “And there is power in numbers, so we look forward to being able to leverage that on behalf of the people of Arizona.” **SOUTH CAROLINA** It was recently discovered that a woke, scandal-plagued school district in Richland County decided to shut parents off from its online library. The South Carolina Freedom Caucus publicly fought back, demanded an explanation, and is investigating if any laws were broken.
Almost immediately, the school district buckled and reinstated online access. Smart move, but that’s not the end of the story. Because of this, angry moms and dads from across the state realized that they finally have a strong ally in the South Carolina Freedom Caucus. One conservative publication [wrote](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=3a857031c2&e=64ecec6d03), “For now, we have to say 'thank you' to the Freedom Caucus for taking this matter so seriously and for acting as a voice for the voiceless parents throughout South Carolina.”
Don’t be surprised if more and more examples of corruption are exposed in SC school districts in the coming weeks and months. The South Carolina Freedom Caucus is pursuing this relentlessly.** ** **ILLINOIS** Earlier this week, the Illinois Freedom Caucus demanded that the state GOP censure Congressman Adam Kinzinger for his complicity with the sham January 6 committee in Washington. ILFC member State Rep. Adam Niemerg [said](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=63054c236c&e=64ecec6d03), "We expect this from Democrats, but it is appalling to see Republicans like Adam Kinzinger play such a prominent part in these proceedings. He should be censured by the Illinois Republican party for his actions.”
Speaking of Illinois, the members of the ILFC were in DC last week to receive training from us on policies and procedures, and to learn how to effectively deal with the media. They also mapped out their pro-freedom agenda for 2023. Thanks to the ILFC, the liberal elites in progressive sanctuary states like Illinois are now getting seriously challenged. **FUNDRAISING** We still need to raise a little more than $1 million to meet our 2022 fundraising goals. If we’re able to secure that support, we can easily expand our state total from 7 states currently to 10-12 states by the end of the year. To donate online, click here: **[https://secure.winred.com/state-freedom-caucus-network/donate-today](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=7b90c53a4a&e=64ecec6d03) **
Or you can mail a check via:

State Freedom Caucus Network
300 Independence Ave SE
Washington, DC 20003 Regards,
Andy Roth
President, State Freedom Caucus Network

subject: Please give me a chance to explain
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
I know just how hard these campaigns can be.
#

[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-july22.t8IncZ&refcode=em220729-1-7&refcode2=3408.6688874.F6utJg&t=1&akid=3408%2E6688874%2EF6utJg)

Friends —
I’m reaching out today to ask you to support my husband, Mark, so he can hold Arizona’s Senate seat. Please, give me a chance to explain why this is so important.
I know just how hard these campaigns can be. It is not easy at all. National Republicans see people like Mark, who are independent and put their constituents first, as a threat. That’s why we’ve always known that outside groups would come out of the woodwork, spending untold amounts of money to try and take back this Senate seat in 2022.
And then Donald Trump flew to Arizona to hold a rally and said, “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.” And he’s already endorsed a GOP-extremist in this race who supports a national abortion ban — with no exceptions.
It's clear Trump and National Republicans are ramping up their efforts to beat Mark. So, what can we do about it?
Mark needs our help to fight off these attacks, and the best way to do that is by making sure he reaches his July fundraising goal before his primary election next Tuesday. We can’t afford to fall short. So, what do you say?
[**If you are able, will you make a $3 donation to Mark’s people-powered campaign? The amount isn’t as important as the donation itself because it’s going to take a lot of people chipping in a few bucks at a time to help reach our July goals.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-july22.t8IncZ&refcode=em220729-1-7&t=2&akid=3408%2E6688874%2EF6utJg)

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7mo2grsf5nje9hcl788kr0vc4tv8llhi32h15bo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shi69ob0cjh2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmsjamv34ljdc3qoh6lt7l33qtr42btt3q3g23l0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shi69ob0cjh2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| |
---
| | | Fellow Conservative,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://trk.readactnews._6d2aXiA "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://trk.readactnews. "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://trk.readactnews. "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://trk.readactnews. "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://trk.readactnews. "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we’re outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://trk.readactnews._IXU8mDeCrovErQWcdXA "I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://trk.readactnews. "I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://trk.readactnews._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjIwNzI5X0FFLVJBTk8uMTAzMTU3X3QxMjE1MjI3LTU2NCJ9/WU9VryiOY-8vLiX0Uqbchw "Footer Graphic 1")
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven’t donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn’t close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we’re only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://trk.readactnews._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjIwNzI5X0FFLVJBTk8uMTAzMTU3X3QxMjE1MjI3LTU2NCJ9/G-3prvd8nvgcFslS_c8Tqw "Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?")**
