subject: 🤔What do the primary results mean?
body:
A message from Michael Peroutka, Republican Candidate for Attorney General of MD
| [ ](https://d2C1H704.na1.hubspotlinksfree.com/Ctc/L0+113/d2C1H704/VWWfxX4MCv5mW7ZnKqf64mKW8W7bJF9w4N4mg2N76MZ-t3lSbNV1-WJV7CgP74W1cXGd97slxyFV2nwDZ24Kp9wW95jHVQ4mstDWN1DFhwHMdCctN13lfYRmqClPN8HCwsfY_yS8W3tPB4H98q3YvW2j1MVM3-1R39W1slYbz1svwRBW2CcF0r42GKs3W3qlj384dnCZFW7YGbZC92XNxTW783rb-3MG-LlW6nwK7967tT9fW3VFKRw57GslQW871Mkd53gYQ3W53p4SY7yPDlBW6d_5kX875N8yW6tpwXz8f4q90W8qR1zR4GkkXFW7DJ01n5CS3PTN1gzrjTvlzM636Jg1)
---
WHAT DO THE PRIMARY RESULTS MEAN? The primary election results demonstrate that Maryland Republicans are dissatisfied with their current leadership. Republicans are clearly rejecting unconstitutional lockdowns and mandates and vaccination policies that violate their God-given rights to assemble, to worship, to run a business, to raise their children, and to have fair and valid elections. They are also rejecting the “conventional wisdom” that says the way to defeat the leftists, globalists, and liberals, is to be just like them. Republicans want something decidedly different. And so do many Democrats. They want to return the great state of Maryland to the rule of law. They want criminals punished and they want their rights restored. They want life protected and liberty defended. By the blood, sweat and tears of our ancestors and by the Grace of a loving and merciful Creator, we have the Maryland Constitution and the Constitution of the United States. These documents are **_not_** designed to govern us. They are designed to govern those who govern us. The people of Maryland want to live under them, and they want leaders that live by them. _We look forward to victory in November. _ _Michael Anthony Peroutka_ _Republican Candidate for Attorney General of MD_
---

| | Derek, It’s been a little over a month since the Supreme Court handed down its appalling decision overturning Roe v. Wade. body:
Democrats are working to lower drug prices, address the climate crisis, and more.

Peter,
We’re just a few days from our end-of-month fundraising deadline — but I wanted to give you a quick update about where things stand in Congress and how it will impact your family.
This week, Democrats announced a new bill called the Inflation Reduction Act that will take important steps to lower costs for prescription drugs and health care, and invest in action on the climate crisis — all paid for by making sure giant corporations and the very wealthiest simply pay their fair share.
I am also continuing my work to make child care more affordable for families in Washington state and across the country. Helping families like yours is my top priority.

name: Delegate Jazz Lewis
subject: Thanks to you, we got it done!
body:
Hello Folks,
I am humbled by our victory in last Tuesday's Primary Election! We needed our supporters to show up and you exceeded all expectations. We were able to cover upwards of twenty polling stations, and visit every polling station in our district, with more than seventy volunteers. I am honored to be heading back to Annapolis to represent District 24.
This campaign has been about our community, like my entire career in public service. We knocked on doors, hosted community events, made thousands of calls, and sent thousands of texts. My goal was to reach every voter with our message of progress, and over ten-thousand constituents honored me with their votes. Thanks to you, I can continue working to ensure there is equal access to justice, healthcare, economic opportunity, affordable housing, & meaningful representation district wide.
Thank you for the privilege of being your delegate!
All my best,
Delegate Jazz Lewis

clean_body: = I have always believed that the law should be a tool for giving a voice to those who have been ignored. In the wake of Roe v. Wade being overturned and Georgia's harsh abortion ban going into effect, it is more important than ever to have an Attorney General who will use the law as a tool for justice rather than oppression. Voters are sick and tired of attempts to legislate personal decisions, and sick of politicians like Chris Carr who have worked to advance restrictive policies. If we want to defeat Carr, we need to maintain the resources — and that's why we must meet our end-of-month deadline in two days. = **= Carr publicly supported the overturning of Roe , and he immediately moved to enact Georgia's restrictive abortion ban after years of defending it. But it's abundantly clear that this law violates the right to privacy guaranteed by our state constitution. I'll fight to overturn this unjust law, and Chris Carr won't. That's the choice Georgians have before them this year. Friend, as Georgia’s Attorney General, I will always stand up for the right to choose and ensure that Georgians are not denied their right to privacy. With our fundamental rights on the ballot this November, I need your help to continue this fight for justice. = Thanks so much, Jen | | | Democratic State Senator Jen Jordan (pronounced Jer-Dun) has spent her legal career fighting for Georgians. Because of her real-life experience in the courtroom and out of it, Jen knows that now, more than ever, we need an Attorney General who will take a stand and fight for the rights of each and every Georgian. =** Paid for by Friends of Jen Jordan, Inc. body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi, it’s Stacey Abrams.

I’m making phone calls again to
supporters like you to
say thank you. Whether you have supported me since 2018 or just last week,
I want to have the chance to say thank you, directly, for all that you do
for my campaign and in your communities.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220729_B1_Calls_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=1209%2E1862389%2EUICC8s ]We need to raise $1 million by July 31st – which will mark 100 days
until Election Day. If you give a donation right now to help us hit our
goal, you might get a thank you call from me. Can you donate
$5 or any amount to contribute to our 100 Day Fund?

[ Stacey ]Stacey Abrams making a phone call with the caption 'Hi, may I speak
with Peggy, please?'

Derek — when
we hit our end-of-month deadline, we will only have 100 days left in this
campaign.

100 days to organize and mobilize voters across the state of Georgia.

100 days to get our message out on TV, over the radio, online and
everywhere else we can.

100 days until voters make their voices heard at the polls and select who
will lead our state for the next four years.

Derek, our $1
million goal for our 100 Days Fund may seem ambitious, but we have plans
for every cent to do everything we can to win in November and get to work
for Georgians.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220729_B1_Calls_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=1209%2E1862389%2EUICC8s ]Can you chip in $5, or whatever makes sense for your
budget today? Any amount — no matter how big or small — might give us a
chance to talk over the phone. I would love the chance to call and thank
you very soon.

Derek, I look
forward to seeing your name on my next call list.

Stacey

| Peter,
The Associated Press reported this week, “With [inflation at a four-decade high](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=f733c50349&e=7dd0b93d07), the [job market strong](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=6348d9cd38&e=7dd0b93d07) and [consumers still spending](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=198b785a54&e=7dd0b93d07), the Federal Reserve is under pressure to continue raising interest rates aggressively.

“When it ends its latest policy meeting Wednesday afternoon, the Fed is expected to impose a second consecutive three-quarter-point hike in its benchmark interest rate, raising it to a range of 2.25% to 2.5%. It will be the Fed’s fourth rate hike since March. Since then, the central bank has tightened credit ever more aggressively.”

This is more bad news for Americans. No matter how Democrats try to spin what’s happening, we all know the truth. Under the policies of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi and Sean Casten our families are spending more to get less. Lies, excuses and spin won't fill gas tanks or pay utility bills. It's time for a change in direction.

Our lawmakers should be focused on protecting American energy production and reserves to reduce the pain on our pocketbooks. I’m going to DC because Americans need legislators who are interested in protecting them, rather than advancing extreme ideology at our expense.

As Mayor of Orland Park, I have fought to protect families and businesses from political ideologues, like Sean Casten. I am going to Congress to do the same. And I am so grateful to have your support in that effort. The fight over the next 3.5 months won’t be easy, but it is one worth having! I look forward to seeing you on the campaign trail soon!
Thank you,

_Keith Pekau_

_If you included those things, we'd have inflation at 17 or 18 percent right now. So at the end of the day, everyone on this call, as well as everyone that's watching knows what is happening in America, knows that we're facing a recession and that we've been seeing inflation that - essentially, at the rate it's at - takes one month of your pay." _

This is Trump's #1 Ally in Congress, Rep. Ronny Jackson. When I was deployed to Iraq as a combat physician, I saw the horrific wounds Marines suffered on the battlefield.

| Hi Friend
As an entrepreneur, I have turned around numerous failing businesses that had just been mismanaged to the ground.
Our Country is facing a recession because of abysmal management and politicians in Congress who think the People's money is their personal credit card. Inflation is at an all-time high and gas prices have gone from worrying to terrifying in the last few months.
Donald Trump brought us prosperity, energy independence, low gas prices, and miraculous growth in manufacturing. We lost all of that with the push to shut down energy production and trillion dollar spending bills designed to pad the wallets of Green Deal conmen.
Democrats and RINOs in Congress have managed to convince many voters that spending and more spending is the answer to everything but you and I know better.
Tacking inflation needs a multi-pronged approach. Some of which I have covered in the video I am embedding in this email.
Let's get the career politicians (who only know how to spend money) out of Congress and elect people who know the value of a dollar.
As your Congressman, I will work to fix inflation with common sense legislation, deregulation, opening up energy production and manufacturing, and proper budget management.
---

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Sign the petition to Congress: Stop premium hikes and extend ACA subsidies now!
body:
Premiums will skyrocket if Congress doesn’t act
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, Temporary health insurance subsidies through the Affordable Care Act are about to expire for next year. Without an extension, health insurance costs will skyrocket, and millions of Americans will become uninsured. As explained in an [article](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbb4b35a2-7fd6-4c9a-8734-3416cd65a120/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) by The Hill, “The American Rescue Plan signed by President Biden last year temporarily increased financial assistance under ObamaCare, but that increase is set to expire at the end of this year, causing an increase in [2023] premiums for enrollees in the health law unless Congress acts.” The report continued, “Notices about the premium increases would be sent out shortly before the midterm elections, adding political pain for Democrats in addition to the higher premiums for consumers.” If Congress fails to extend tax credits, premiums will skyrocket, with 3 million people at risk of losing coverage. Premium increases will be widespread, with insurers pursuing double-digit increases affecting 9 million Americans. [**Congress can prevent outrageous health insurance increases and widespread health coverage loss by extending the American Rescue Plan’s tax credits. Sign the petition to Congress: Stop premium hikes and extend ACA subsidies now!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6d4999cb-1252-4de0-8d06-b0f22f6b3823/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---

---
|
---
| | | Failing to extend these tax credits will also aggravate existing geographical and racial disparities, particularly in rural states like West Virginia, where premiums are already an average of 10% higher than in urban areas. On top of heavy inflation impacting consumers at the grocery store, gas pump, and more, millions of Americans will receive a notice in the mail in October that their ACA premiums will rise significantly. [**Congress can prevent outrageous health insurance increases and widespread health coverage loss by extending the American Rescue Plan’s tax credits. Sign the petition to Congress: Stop premium hikes and extend ACA subsidies now!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdfdfef40-844b-4bbb-82da-dbbc7308663c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Fellow Conservative,

We've got some disturbing news to share. For the first time since they began forecasting the 2022 midterm elections, Nate Silver's _FiveThirtyEight_ predicts Democrats have the advantage over Republicans in the race to control the U.S. Senate.

This is _not good_.

Here's the deal:

**Republicans are being outraised, outspent, and outpolled around the country, and the mainstream media is in the bag for the Democrats.** Despite President Biden's tumbling approval rating and the highest inflation in 40 years, Democrats actually have a shot at holding onto the Senate majority.

_But let me tell you why we can’t lose any momentum, especially right now._
1. While most people are enjoying a nice picnic outside, my Radical Left opponent is posting record-breaking fundraising numbers. **She brought in $7.4 million in the last 3 months alone.**
2. Every poll is showing an extremely tight race this November. We’re nowhere near a comfortable victory, and everyone knows North Carolina could be the swing seat that decides control of the Senate.
3. With Democrats controlling the House, the Senate, _and_ the White House, it is absolutely crucial we take this seat in order to stop the Biden/Beasley agenda. Chuck Schumer would be elated to have Radical Cheri Beasley in the Senate with him – and we can’t let that happen.

clean_body: | Hey Peter, I’ve spent some time on my farm in North Carolina recently, where I’ve been enjoying the summer. North Carolina is great – we’ve got beautiful beaches, picturesque mountains, and superior barbeque. But there is one bad thing about summer. Unfortunately, summer typically means a drop in our fundraising numbers. And understandably so – people are spending more time outdoors with family and friends, not focusing on politics. I get it. But let me tell you why we can’t lose any momentum, especially right now. 1. While most people are enjoying a nice picnic outside, my Radical Left opponent is posting record-breaking fundraising numbers. She brought in $7.4 million in the last 3 months alone. 2. Every poll is showing an extremely tight race this November. We’re nowhere near a comfortable victory, and everyone knows North Carolina could be the swing seat that decides control of the Senate. 3. With Democrats controlling the House, the Senate, and the White House, it is absolutely crucial we take this seat in order to stop the Biden/Beasley agenda. Chuck Schumer would be elated to have Radical Cheri Beasley in the Senate with him – and we can’t let that happen. | Our work is nowhere near done, and we get closer to November 8th with each passing minute. Friend, I'm running for Congress in one of the most competitive seats in the entire country, and I wanted to take a moment to explain why this fight is so important to me. In a moment, I'll ask you to contribute to my campaign – but if you don’t have time (and that’s okay!), can you please **[chip in now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48496621/358461597/-2022851510?refcode=em_fr_2022.07.29_b1_AS_all&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZjMyNTA5OS01ODBmLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5TzWvcqdQVPPEC9GQmeLKpMHESgyooDluzinrvpoKQw=)** I believe that change can happen in a generation if we work for it. I know, because it happened for me. My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. My parents couldn’t afford to send me to college, so I juggled multiple jobs – from painting homes to pouring coffee – while attending UC Berkeley. It took me seven years, but I earned that degree and it opened doors for me that I hadn't thought possible before. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. My parents couldn’t afford to send me to college, so I juggled multiple jobs – from painting homes to pouring coffee – while attending UC Berkeley. It took me seven years, but I earned that degree and it opened doors for me that I hadn't thought possible before. body:
Hello, Kevin Hayslett Supporters!

The momentum is picking up! If you have not already heard the news, the district's [latest professional scientific poll](https://hayslettforcongress.com/2022/07/28/breaking-kevin-hayslett-statistically-tied-with-anna-paulina-luna-in-republican-primary-for-fl-13/) found that Kevin Hayslett and Anna Paulina Luna are now statistically tied. The data suggests that Anna Paulina Luna has a ceiling of support and cannot pick up new voters. Kevin, however, is finding further support at an increasing rate. Undecideds are breaking for Kevin.

There are only __25 days left until the Republican Primary on August 23rd__ , and we need your help! The following dates are for all our volunteer events this next week. Tomorrow we will focus on canvassing the town of Clay with two shifts: one in the morning and another in the afternoon. We will provide palm cards and show you how to work our App for knocking doors. name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgtbijmebgtk7n1jeq6e8hqlhp3mmcm1hnp7o750_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij791lmkp79dhk6eojacpl6er7actl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4oni6aob2dhmm1pj6s3lmeqmao5m69p38t366dqb7dbgmsq38srh6ap6ec3mm2qn0puie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74cb6e2ob6or7m9omcdj0m9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zalmm6ck0sbt1g42u07ac8vgm6qe2feaol6160lg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjoqmnlcjj7bqvrqhae0pl02acdl4cc40aohgreg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5t204efcrs2a6f0cgua3co5q8gmnrfp9t9hpds0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znnr90asfd6mgom1oif7bs5jp48uv36rd6f5ra9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zqo665iomp8kqskp7k6ptdnor5cs0tl63p0a1oh0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl0hkfbsifddf6u17d5ispohdr7f0o12h4ee4o60_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1uarl8ukujdpkd7rp25li7s91phmcv9b1gg5s9g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmh7ku6qeg0o5j70j1f78iqs6es6ja4626r47k00_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zibsa8fnjudntkarukhldl79kce4rubia82rj6vg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zv4o0qr04e3gnjf59j9ge39234idv607etriot08_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zatqmb7cne74jod3lfdvckb5lt5m8fvkvtvokre0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3itoojdb97bhagt1v1gptljgmalat66tbiktol8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6m7b5hd437lfsmd3uf558bt6cmcmnoc4uttrpqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6kh1qif1hnqlriu5r1mb4hcjq5hp5lqpltd9000_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrs9q13g75gmu5alagj7hdt1liqd2tmcdci9t3og_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcsngp3b8o44em57n70tneabrl4mheocparrdv5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zu78ka72htu0k5rb02no2j9qvt6m5p81788jpjhg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zgfmru21jaa6t42bkr7ahn87uv2h1nc1vlq7sfag_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shh66or4c3h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation
If dpwillis67@gmail.com should not be subscribed or if you need to change your subscription information for American Defense News, [please use this preferences page](https://e.americandefensenews.com/prefs/9z2z6hpiq3uu9vt2no9hsnb754l028dihjg2jrgrfj8).
625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

| Migrants are flooding across our borders illegally in numbers that make it virtually impossible to prosecute and deport them under the status quo. I've heard from ICE officials that they need prosecutors to work through a backlog of more than 1.6 million illegal immigration cases created by the crisis on our southern border
That's why I am introducing the Surging Prosecutors to Expedite Alien Removals Act. My bill would simply require a 4-to-1 ratio of ICE prosecutors to immigration judges so the Department of Homeland Security is adequately represented in immigration proceedings. While there have been increases in the number of immigration judges, there has not been a corresponding increase in prosecutors. If this doesn't change, the legal process cannot properly function and illegal immigrants will continue to be released into our country instead of being deported.
This is just the latest of several serious legislative proposals I've introduced to address the illegal immigration crisis on our southern border. Unfortunately, these bills will never see the light of day as long as Nancy Pelosi is Speaker of the House.
That's why we need to put everything we've got into these next 100 days until the November elections. We must be tireless in our efforts to take back the House so we can finally start putting our country back on the right path.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: A 14-cent microchip, & a brand new phase in a 2-year story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220729&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220729&amount=28]
Team,
If you haven’t already heard, let me be the first to share some great news with you: the CHIPS Act just passed, and with the President’s signature this week, it will finally be over the finish line. This bill, which passed on a bipartisan basis (with votes from two Republican members of Michigan’s congressional delegation, Rep. Fred Upton and Rep. Peter Meijer), will provide incentives for companies to manufacture the microchips that power everything – from our cars, to our cell phones, to our dishwashers – right here in the U.S.
I’m happy to say that the FABS Act, a bill I introduced, is in the final version of this package and will offer tax credits for businesses that build these plants in places like Michigan. The CHIPS Act also builds in strong safeguards against corporate greed to make sure semiconductor companies live up to their commitments – things like prevailing wage requirements, and provisions that ensure American firms can’t use CHIPS Act subsidies to invest overseas..
All in all, this means new plants, thousands of new jobs throughout the midwest, and lower prices for consumers on everyday goods.
The global shortage of microchips has dominated my work over the past two years. During that time, auto plants across the country and in my district have closed on and off because they haven’t been able to get their hands on a 14-cent microchip. It’s something I hear about every time I’m home – at my events people will literally break out into chants of “CHIPS! CHIPS! CHIPS!” whenever the topic pops up.
And not only is this a win for Michigan, but it will also strengthen our national security by ensuring that we’re no longer completely reliant on foreign powers for the microchips found in our military equipment. I got a first-hand look at just how dangerous it is to be so reliant on foreign entities for this type of equipment last year, when I led a bipartisan task force to examine our defense supply chains. Bringing this critical manufacturing back to the U.S. means we won’t be held hostage in the event of a conflict with a country like China.
This is an important issue in Michigan, and you can’t run for Congress without being firm in your beliefs on the issues that matter most to the people you want to represent. That’s why yesterday, I called on my opponent to state publicly whether he would have supported this legislation or not.
We're at a point in American history where we need to make a decision: Are we going to invest in our ability to make chips at home, or are we going to allow ourselves to grow more and more dependent on Asia? I’ve made it clear where I come down on that. It’s time for my opponent to do the same.

name: Chrissy
subject: Women deserve access to the care they need
body:
Reproductive freedom is at stake in America, even here in Pennsylvania
| | |
---
Derek, reproductive rights are human rights, full stop. That's why I've spent my time in Congress advocating for women, making sure they have equity and the fundamental right to make decisions about their own health.
**One of the best ways we can fight back is by passing legislation to codify Roe v. Wade – which we did in the House just the other week.**
It's critical that women access the help and care they need. That's why I'm working to improve maternal health care access through the Maternal Health Quality Improvement Act. I've also advanced bipartisan legislation to scale up access to affordable child care, expand the availability of paid family leave and end pregnancy discrimination.
And that’s on top of the progress we’ve already earned: I'm proud to say I helped lead the historic effort to enact twelve weeks of paid parental leave for more than two million federal workers, which I'm working to expand to all Americans.
Reproductive freedom is at stake in America, even here in Pennsylvania, with extremist Republicans running up and down the ballot vowing to enact abortion bans across our commonwealth and country.
**As a mom, teacher and veteran, I'm not backing down from this fight. Since joining Congress, I've championed reproductive rights, and I will continue to do so.**
**[With so much at stake, Derek, will you make a donation right now to help me continue the fight to protect our reproductive rights?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48511689/358522093/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk624-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MjBjMGExYS04MjBmLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FbmXms3US1XkVhXvAKe5_hKJCC7SnOycIoAAtb_cvAQ=)**

clean_body: Reproductive freedom is at stake in America, even here in Pennsylvania | | | Derek, reproductive rights are human rights, full stop. That's why I've spent my time in Congress advocating for women, making sure they have equity and the fundamental right to make decisions about their own health. One of the best ways we can fight back is by passing legislation to codify Roe v. Wade – which we did in the House just the other week. It's critical that women access the help and care they need. That's why I'm working to improve maternal health care access through the Maternal Health Quality Improvement Act. I've also advanced bipartisan legislation to scale up access to affordable child care, expand the availability of paid family leave and end pregnancy discrimination. And that’s on top of the progress we’ve already earned: I'm proud to say I helped lead the historic effort to enact twelve weeks of paid parental leave for more than two million federal workers, which I'm working to expand to all Americans. Reproductive freedom is at stake in America, even here in Pennsylvania, with extremist Republicans running up and down the ballot vowing to enact abortion bans across our commonwealth and country. As a mom, teacher and veteran, I'm not backing down from this fight. | | | [](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=0cff34a73e&e=007b353608)

Happy Friday, Team!

As you know, I’m a former Barrier To Entry congressional candidate. Despite not winning my race, I was deeply proud of the competitive campaign and movement we built thanks to B/E. That’s why I was so thrilled to join this team as Director of Campaigns so that I could support other working-class progressives running for office.

One of the first candidates I’ve had the pleasure of working with has been **[Daniel Ortiz](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=f7a2887565&e=007b353608)** in his race to represent Ohio’s 43rd State House District. Daniel is as real as it gets. He’s down-to-earth, genuinely kind, and fiercely passionate about the progressive causes we are all fighting for. His bold plans include making healthcare and prescription drugs accessible, bringing clean energy to Ohio, knocking down Republican attempts to outlaw abortion, keeping families safe from gun violence, and beyond.

**But last week, Daniel’s well-funded opponent resorted to some pretty dirty tactics by launching misleading attack mailers against him.** Daniel’s been running a clean, honest primary campaign since Day One. His strategy has been to highlight his strengths and visions for the future. Meanwhile, his opponent is busy tearing down another Democrat.

**We URGENTLY need to counter these attacks — and we plan to do that by continuing to take the high road, focusing on energizing voters and spreading Daniel’s positive message.

** That’s why I’m asking you sincerely and personally today if you would consider donating any amount right now to help us support our working-class progressive candidates as they struggle to pave their way in a political space that favors those who already have the upper hand. **[We only have 4 DAYS until the election, so if we’re going to reach key voters on time, we’ve can't miss our end-of-month goal of raising $4,200 by this weekend. name: Ralph Rebandt For Governor
subject: Prayer and Fasting - Unite Together
body:
Prayer Calls Tonight

| [ ](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=1)
---
**Join The Prayer Call Tonight** Dear Ralph Rebandt for Governor Team & Prayer Warriors We will be having prayers calls, join when you can! **Tonight, Friday 9:30pm** **Call 605-313-4829** **Then enter 694177#** For anyone who would like to join in Praying and Fasting, we have a team that will be praying and fasting the entire day of the election. Here are some things that we can flood the throne of God with together, as we join together- \- Father, Son Jesus Christ, and Holy Spirit, we acknowledge and glorify you as God, we give you Praise. \- We confess our shortcomings, and ask your forgiveness. \- We are SO THANKFUL Lord that you have brought us this far! \- Lord, Ralph meets the qualifications of whom You Lord have said you will look to in Isaiah 66. The one who is humble, contrite in spirit, and trembles at Your Word. Please Lord, as we your people ask in agreement, please listen to the voice of Your children in Michigan as we ask for our choice for Governor in Michigan to be Ralph Rebandt. Lord, the only reason we ask this so passionately of You is that we believe He is Your choice as he meets these qualifications. Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven, Lord. We believe You are Able! \- That every heart and every mind that is able to vote will hear about Ralph, and be inclined to vote for him. \- That God would appoint 'an east wind' when the sun rises on election day, bringing about a miraculous win for Ralph on August 2nd, 2022. \- That God would work with wave upon wave in the hearts and minds of each voter, with an overflow of what is needed to win this election. \- That God would use everything- individual efforts, letters to churches, flyers in car handles and windows, commercials, text messages, rallies, people, radio, and Anything else possible to get Ralph to the seat of Governor in Michigan if it is His Will. Ralph desires Psalm 138:2, "Your Name and Your Word you have elevated above all else." \- That the Holy Spirit would make up ALL the difference in our weaknesses in how we do not know how to pray- "Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words." (Romans 8:26) Holy Spirit, please intercede Yourself for us in this area of prayer as you have promised to do. May the Will of the Father be done, in Jesus Name. Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow. Lord, we look to You. In Jesus Name, Amen! **Reminder - Byron Days Festival Parade** The Byron Days Festival is this weekend in Byron Center. We are going to have a group of supporters walking in the parade on Saturday at 10 am. If you live in the area and want to support Ralph at this event, we encourage you to attend the parade and join our supporters as they walk. The website for the festival can be found below. | [](https://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/r?u=cv6uGi6UmqBOq_GjCPLIHSZeb8FYIm_91zDwTu87IuQ&e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=2 "FESTIVAL WEBSITE") [FESTIVAL WEBSITE](https://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/r?u=cv6uGi6UmqBOq_GjCPLIHSZeb8FYIm_91zDwTu87IuQ&e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=2)
---
**Reminder - Ralph Rebandt for Governor Rally**
****
If you are in the Grand Rapids area don't miss the Ralph Rebandt for Governor rally this Sunday with former Rep. Tom Hooker and Jim VanSteenhouse, "The Bear Man". This event is free of charge and we hope to see you there!
### **4 Days Until August 2nd!**
There is less than a week left in the Primary election and we have seen tremendous support in this last month. We are currently launching a special advertising campaign and are continuing to seek financial contributions that go directly to this advertising. If you would like your contribution to go to this campaign, donate $101, or any amount ending with a 1 such as $31, or $41. This will make it easy for us to direct your contribution properly.
Please Consider donating or volunteering to help us make **Michigan a Lighthouse to The Nation.**
[](https://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/donate?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=3 "DONATE ANY AMOUNT") [DONATE ANY AMOUNT](https://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/donate?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=3)
---
Thank you for your continued support.
Ralph Rebandt For Governor
[](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=4)[](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=5)[](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=6)[](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=7)[](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=8)[http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_team&n=9)

[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=453fa0e5fc&e=00028e5542)
[**FL-14 frontrunner James Judge picks up endorsement from Community Patriots**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=3c79116e4f&e=00028e5542)
_Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary James Judge received an endorsement from Community Patriots Tampa._ TAMPA, Fla. – The Republican leader in the primary race in Florida’s 14th Congressional District has been endorsed by the well-known grassroots conservative organization Community Patriots Tampa, the campaign announced Friday.“James Judge is a Tampa local and a strong conservative, and we are honored to endorse him in his race for Florida’s 14th Congressional District,” said Jeff Hawks, founder of the group. “James shares our beliefs in strong conservative values like supporting law and order, protecting our Second Amendment from unconstitutional "gun grabs", reducing the federal debt and providing solutions for America’s inflation crisis.”Judge is running to unseat incumbent Democrat Kathy Castor, who notoriously supports soft-on-crime policies like defunding the police, along with progressive policies like unfettered abortion, gun control and reckless spending.Judge happily accepted the endorsement from Community Patriots Tampa.“Community Patriots is a force for good in the Tampa area,” Judge said. “Now more than ever, we need strong grassroots organizations to band together and fight for our cause. Community Patriots does just that, and I’m looking forward to fighting alongside the group and its members. I thank them for their support, and I’m thrilled to have their endorsement.”Judge has also received support and endorsements from the Tampa Bay Times, legendary political consultant Roger Stone, Rep. Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

We've got some disturbing news to share. For the first time since they began forecasting the 2022 midterm elections, Nate Silver's _FiveThirtyEight_ predicts Democrats have the advantage over Republicans in the race to control the U.S. Senate.

This is _not good_.

Here's the deal:

**Republicans are being outraised, outspent, and outpolled around the country, and the mainstream media is in the bag for the Democrats.** Despite President Biden's tumbling approval rating and the highest inflation in 40 years, Democrats actually have a shot at holding onto the Senate majority.

_I'm absolutely floored._
I know that it's summer and many people are still on vacation or taking a breather from everyday life, but here's the deal: **if we don't act quickly, our Senate campaign will lose because we don't have the money to compete.**

We hate to keep asking for support, but it's critical that our campaign have the resources to respond to repeated attacks and set the record straight. _**Right now, we don't have enough money to respond.**_

I’m Tracy Mitrano, Democratic Candidate for Congress in NY-23 in 2018 and 2020. For the first time, I am reaching out in support of Josh Riley for Congress in the new NY-19.

I took on Tom Reed in NY-23 in both 2018 and 2020. While we did not win those elections, it was a battle worth fighting because the Southern Tier deserved better representation, and, due to our efforts, we did finally get an irresponsible politician to leave office.

Now, Josh is running in a brand new district that overlaps with a part of the old NY-23. I’m all-in to help him win and to secure for the people of the Southern Tier responsible representation in Congress.

As a former candidate, I know that fundraising can be the worst part of the job, but it’s also one of the most important. Funds fuel communication. For the first time, I am reaching out in support of Josh Riley for Congress in the new NY-19. I took on Tom Reed in NY-23 in both 2018 and 2020. While we did not win those elections, it was a battle worth fighting because the Southern Tier deserved better representation, and, due to our efforts, we did finally get an irresponsible politician to leave office. Now, Josh is running in a brand new district that overlaps with a part of the old NY-23. I’m all-in to help him win and to secure for the people of the Southern Tier responsible representation in Congress. As a former candidate, I know that fundraising can be the worst part of the job, but it’s also one of the most important. Funds fuel communication. Some of our most progressive WFP champions are the prime targets of these deep-pocketed, outside groups | | | Peter, our next big fundraising deadline is in just 2 days — **but****that’s not the only thing on our minds right now:** This year’s Democratic primaries are seeing an unprecedented avalanche of right wing and corporate Super PAC spending. The biggest new conservative spender this cycle is AIPAC’s Super PAC, called the “United Democracy Project” or UDP. _They’ve spent roughly $20 million in Democratic primaries so far this cycle alone._ **Some of our most progressive WFP champions are the prime targets** of these deep-pocketed, outside groups, like Andy Levin (MI-11), Rashida Tlaib (MI-12), and Cori Bush (MO-01) – and they all have huge primaries over the next two weeks. **_[We’re doing everything we can to fight back against this onslaught of cash, get them across the finish line, and show that we can take on big corporate money and win. To do that, it’s really critical that we raise the remaining $19,214 we need to reach our July goal. Will you chip in $6 to pull off this major feat?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUgcQK6aH_-JeGa8uRtM1NCriDxzZuA2blvw6S6V5NTe3hTtran5b0mHANGOx_tvUWv55k4yqrKMvVhMa4BqnhRAYnaPGoKQryJ3U27bvTZqEN76HRsrfuKYIqN6fJZ6sXhQNqdLcCV6Z6fB-uYTO00-g5dwoT214THw6EG8z0gfjwefCsdaLybyFGRYtALgLoiz-PZJVU1cAnUIcdAInKf4AFAHnBVZ9acfofGJag_ifaf_fKQKWVKMhXx2lwxVTGc4agLYqQe9IJXeJYu9gibIBSDxfQrTOQfZg_mFFJPBM/3o5/HkkqGkRZRZWeGG7cF8TicQ/h0/URS9H6PxYcuCGHoAU0T-bachSkyX29X95FmZXvwHe9I)_** **[Contribute $6 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUgcQK6aH_-JeGa8uRtM1NCriDxzZuA2blvw6S6V5NTe3hTtran5b0mHANGOx_tvUWftaG_eafs5GQIVoXuDwHBBDCWyCG_9JnROUL_A4CgcTEGk3qvcpE8lybjNrRa-94BTbh0i3jEXvt-USeSsWOaItbNrueCtHeSzpKV_f3KrvOWpj8hFOMrBdU1N4MWBOGBU65Fgqw1ROCjp9GJNw_f1vo8C9FfePYkDayCjcTeVjdyTijsvXXJHZTxTAJ2JvGqRw6PMc0f23HEmJbzjMqvKcnpKYotzuQMvxFVTUqWEI/3o5/HkkqGkRZRZWeGG7cF8TicQ/h1/6slMryKcjwMbRzZzpqGwtHL_Fu8vwHiY4GJSc8fXhKc)** **We’ve learned from this cycle that progressives can get outspent and still win.** We saw it happen with WFP candidates Summer Lee and Jamie McLeod-Skinner when they defeated their corporate Democrat opponents and delivered huge wins for the Working Families Party. **But it’s one thing to be outspent 2-1 and something else entirely to get outspent 5-1 or 10-1.** This kind of lopsided resource advantage is hard for anyone to overcome and we saw its devastating effect in other House races. The biggest new conservative spender this cycle is AIPAC’s Super PAC, called the “United Democracy Project” or UDP. They’ve spent roughly $20 million in Democratic primaries so far this cycle alone. Some of our most progressive WFP champions are the prime targets of these deep-pocketed, outside groups, like Andy Levin (MI-11), Rashida Tlaib (MI-12), and Cori Bush (MO-01) – and they all have huge primaries over the next two weeks. We’ve learned from this cycle that progressives can get outspent and still win. We saw it happen with WFP candidates Summer Lee and Jamie McLeod-Skinner when they defeated their corporate Democrat opponents and delivered huge wins for the Working Families Party. But it’s one thing to be outspent 2-1 and something else entirely to get outspent 5-1 or 10-1. name: Ron DeSantis
subject: I'm here to lead
body:
I’m truly grateful for staunch allies like you. It wouldn’t be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjus2b3q7pjmaovhfidi0663rurf4tnroa16egm0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor2c9h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij78bielqr0sbiegqb7ctl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onl6srr7d9gcerb4dr3mapmad73mmq70tjhmcp62slnm9hm9o5hc1ge6cthmhqbeduie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74cb6e2pb6p1nm9p6cd70m9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
**[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhnn1vhbucs73ec6d6atrb8kgcvc19d497ibrj3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor2c9h2bs)**
Friend,
I’m truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn’t be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I’m taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden’s Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left’s destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left’s draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I’m glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**
**Every business has a right to operate.**
That’s why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. [_**Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkqkvh59k2lkc4gbfnn60vsn4uums4qhflool9g0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor2c9h2bs)
I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.
I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. _**I fought back.**_
It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don’t cower with fear about what the media may say — _I just lead_.
In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida’s 46th Governor, I didn’t let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.
I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:
✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.
✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child’s needs.
✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.
✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.
Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.
**Over my first three years, I’ve continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
[_**Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9aibjpgooglg2lvjmdasv92t7kvk1t1sk9jlbko_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor2c9h2bs)
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.
I certainly don’t set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley’s CEOs, Big Tech’s shady algorithms, or the corrupt media’s agenda!
I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.
**I was elected to lead, not to follow.**
As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.
I’m proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as _the freest state in the country._
Yet rather than celebrate our economy, our school children being freed of compulsory masking, and the influx of overtaxed Americans who are voting with their feet to move to Florida, I am being attacked by my Democrat opponents.
I know you understand that coordinated attacks and vitriol against a successful conservative Republican like me is business as usual from the lockdown Democrats. It’s pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments.
**As Governor of Florida, I’ll never stop defending the pro-liberty, pro-free market policies that make Florida the beachhead of freedom for the nation.**
My re-election campaign sent SHOCK WAVES through the Democrat media complex when we announced a $5 MILLION ad reservation targeting Hispanic voters.
With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.
**I’m going to battle for every vote.**
As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor!
We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight.
Now, with just months to go until Election Day, I’m asking you to stand with me again by making another generous contribution to my campaign today.
With November fast approaching, I’m hoping you can double your most generous gift.
[**[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW]**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zu5c7kpnae096k4snoi5ftppp7e66kn7tg871k5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor2c9h2bs)
Regardless of the amount, I simply must have your continued support to be ready to respond to the next round of distortions and lies my Biden-loving opponents hurl at me.
_Friend, I’m incredibly grateful to you for your continued support._
No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden’s big government.
For Florida,
Ron DeSantis
[DONATE NOW](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgp3tn8ssv8va331ctrkssoqp4miijkuqrtq6j5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor2c9h2bs)

Friend,

_The Washington Post_ reported this morning that my GOP opponent has been spreading blatant lies about the pro-choice policies Democrats are trying to advance after the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade. **He also made an utterly offensive comparison between legalizing abortion and the Holocaust.**

I'll let his words speak for themselves: _"The Nazis did this. They’ll take Jewish babies and just take the legs and just smash the babies and kill them. You think that can’t happen in this country?"_ **My opponent's words are insulting, and they show just how out of step he is with the people of Virginia's 10th District.**

The far right is desperately pushing misinformation about abortion, because they know that the strong majority of voters favor letting women make their own medical decisions. And since the facts aren't on the far right's side, they've stooped to invoking some of the worst historical atrocities.

This type of rhetoric should have no place in our politics. I am determined to push back on it, and stop lies and extremism from prevailing in Northern Virginia. Now more than ever, my constituents need a leader who's committed to protecting their fundamental rights. It's clear that my opponent will not be that leader.

[**Please, can you donate any amount to make sure we can win this race? name: American Action News
subject: Is socialism on the rise?
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zegqnhck8qnknce742hm9ikkr3vkcodh62opc77o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor4cth238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8tj56jhn6p9mmqp7acb5cpom8t35m9q71pbjelrb6t9h6op72tlhe5ojbcbgm3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor9d9gs1pbaphh6ipmadtgmlin49fg)
| | | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmjp814ldtcknh2j5849kgddtabe9jg26pkbojd8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor4cth2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0btcq8h2mdh46jravujbqqfr3cst34is1mo3ljg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor4cth2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3pslocluk7r092gprvl86bt5tkdoajklq6hdgbg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shj6aor4cth2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Congressman Andy Levin is a bold progressive and one of the most effective legislators in Congress and the billionaire class has taken notice. The American-Israel Public Affairs Committee(AIPAC) has spent nearly $24 million(and counting) to take out progressives this cycle. AIPAC & Co. primarily target progressive women of color, like Summer Lee, Jessica Cisneros, Donna Edwards, Attica Scott, Erica Smith, and Nida Allam to name a few — and Andy Levin?
---
Andy is a union organizer who has stood strong with labor outside and inside the halls of Congress. His advocacy for workers right’s made it possible for Congressional staffers to unionize for the first time ever after Andy introduced the Recognizing Congressional Workers' Right to Organize resolution. From Amazon to Starbucks, workers are reclaiming their power, and Andy’s got their backs. This race could also shape the future protections and rights of gig workers. In 2019, Andy's opponent, Haley Stevens, wrote an amendment excluding gig workers from the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act. Andy was elected in 2018 and quickly set out to challenge the status quo by fighting for healthcare as human right, signing on as an original cosponsor of the Medicare for All Act. In response to the current climate crisis, he immediately signed on as an original cosponsor of the Green New Deal. Andy has authored the Electric Vehicle (EV) Freedom Act, which would pave the way to a zero-emissions transportation system and bring our infrastructure into a sustainable 21st century. Andy supports the Clean Economy Act, which would set a national goal to achieve a 100-percent clean economy by 2050, meeting the Paris Climate Agreement standards. Stevens on the other hand supports Line 5, which is an oil pipeline that would be devastating to the Enbridge Lakehead system and would continue to keep our oil dependency alive. The sad truth is not all Democrats are created equal, and Republicans are salivating at the idea of holding the American people hostage in the House as they have done so effectively in the Senate, thanks to “Democrats” like Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema. These next 5 days will be crucial. While AIPAC is mostly funded by a handful of billionaires, we are powered by the movement that's been growing in our communities. body:
Our plan | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/drscottjensen.com/support-women?e=33b11688c1)
---
| |
---
| | Peter,

In the wake of the overturning of Roe v. Wade, Minnesotans have engaged in many poignant conversations regarding the topic and have reached out to Matt Birk and me. I want voters to know where we stand. One month ago, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and pushed the question of abortion rights to the states. In Minnesota, this has no impact, because in 1995 our Supreme Court ruled, in Doe vs. Gomez, that abortion availability is assured within our state's constitution. This has raised up many ideas on how we can best support women and children and how we can enact policies that make sense to give loving and caring support for women and kids in Minnesota. **Please,[see our plan by clicking here](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=c103c8fc3e&e=33b11688c1) and watch our policy video by clicking the thumbnail below:**
---
| [ ](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=cc0b271a51&e=33b11688c1 "A Plan to Support and Protect Women")
---
| We can and should discuss the various scenarios involving unexpected pregnancies, and I would not require any survivor of rape or incest to continue any associated pregnancy. But, I want to be perfectly clear that the Minnesota Supreme Court decision on Doe vs. Gomez establishes access to abortion. A constitutional amendment to change such access requires legislative action and such an action is conducted entirely outside of the Governor's purview or approval.

**The real extremist is Tim Walz.** In May 2022, Walz called on Congress to pass a sweeping bill enshrining abortion-until-birth in federal law. Further, this legislation would eliminate almost all existing protections for unborn children across the country - including Minnesota’s parental notification and informed consent laws, as well as Minnesota’s law limiting the performance of abortion to licensed physicians. [See the details here](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=b66ba486ff&e=33b11688c1).

[Our plan](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=e660f0c082&e=33b11688c1) will uplift, support, and protect women!
---
|
In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for Governor - Minnesota

**Mid-Term Elections Are Only 100 Days Away!**
In just over three-months time, voters will head to the polls to give elected officials their annual report cards. If recent headlines are any indication, many office holders are going to receive failing grades.While members of Congress currently enjoy protection from term limits, elections are the only method we have to send poor performing representatives packing. With just 100 days to go, it’s time for a full-court press of campaign activity!This weekend hundreds of volunteers will fan out across District 1, going door-to-door in support of the full slate of Republican candidates. We know of efforts in York, Cumberland and Kennebec Counties on both Saturday and Sunday. There are sure to be more groups than we know about! To get in touch with the organizers:
* In Cumberland County email Josh@MaineGOP.com
* In York County email Brendan@MaineGOP.com
* In Kennebec County email Emily@MaineGOP.com

Next week we will begin lawn sign distribution! To order your lawn sign(s), simply reply to this email or call (207) 449-5636 and leave a message.Every day is a good day to write a letter-to-the-editor of your local paper! Let your community know you support Ed Thelander for Congress. Tell them how the current representation has led to record high inflation, sky-rocketing fuel and oil prices, increasing crime, and a porous southern border. The general decline in the American standard of living in the 19 months of this administration is stunning in its speed and severity! If you need help writing a letter, simply reply to this email or call (207) 449-5636 and leave a message.In the final 100 Days we will begin communicating to the many undecided voters through direct mail, radio, digital and phones. This is where your financial help is truly needed! Please consider hitting the donate button and donate for the final 100 days push!As Ed says on the campaign trail, _**“A Red Wave won’t happen unless we MAKE it happen!”**_

Peter,
It’s the midterms. Protecting our congressional majorities is a top priority.
State and local elections matter, too. Decisions made in down-ballot races can have a significant impact on our daily life, sometimes even more so than those made in federal contests.
Will you fill out our official 2022 Down-Ballot Races Survey today [https://takeaction.democratsserve.org/a/down-ballot-races-2022-survey]?
TAKE OUR SURVEY >> [https://takeaction.democratsserve.org/a/down-ballot-races-2022-survey]
Whether it’s been working in government at the state and municipal levels, or currently serving as a local elected official, I’ve seen first-hand the direct impact that decisions made by voters in down-ballot races can have on their communities.
With this in mind, right now Democrats Serve is making critical decisions on what down-ballot races to focus on in 2022. And, we need your input.
Your support remains vital to furthering Democrats Serve’s mission of helping Democratic candidates with public service backgrounds run for office — at the federal, state, and local levels — and win elections. So, that means we really need to hear from you.
Will you please take the survey today [https://takeaction.democratsserve.org/a/down-ballot-races-2022-survey] ?
Thanks for your continued support.
Brett
Brett Broesder
Executive Director
Democrats Serve

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

**Despite knowing the risks climate change poses, the United States Supreme Court has massively undermined President Biden 's ability to act. Today, Congress is debating a new package which would be a critical step forward, but we also know we can't rely on them alone -- the states must also act.**

name: Rachel Patterson, Evergreen Action
subject: Biden's EPA is about to make pollution worse
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
Submit a public comment to stop this mistake before it happens.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/sign-on-ca_cleaner_trucks_comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&t=2&akid=13084%2E53494%2E8BHu-Z) | **Since the passage of the _Clean Air Act_ , California has been allowed to set more aggressive tailpipe emissions standards than the national standard. Now, the trucking industry is suing the EPA to pressure the Biden administration to deny California’s authority, threatening to set back years of progress toward reducing tailpipe pollution. **

[**_Submit a public comment to urge the EPA to approve California’s full vehicle emissions waiver authority today!_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/sign-on-ca_cleaner_trucks_comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&t=3&akid=13084%2E53494%2E8BHu-Z)
---

| [TAKE ACTION](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/sign-on-ca_cleaner_trucks_comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&t=4&akid=13084%2E53494%2E8BHu-Z)
---
Friend,
Growing up in California, my sister and I rode the bus to school and back. Two hours each day, Monday through Friday.
It's no surprise that we both developed asthma. Tailpipe emissions -- like the ones from our school bus -- are a leading source of nitrogen oxides and other pollutants that can lead to lung and heart disease.
My sister often had to miss school and was hospitalized routinely for asthma. I'll never forget visiting her at the hospital when we were kids, seeing oxygen tubes in her nose and a machine helping her stay alive.
**Tailpipe emissions cause thousands of Americans to suffer this way. That's why we're urging the EPA to grant California's full waiver authority to reduce deadly tailpipe pollution and pave the way for other states to do the same.**
[**_Will you sign an official public comment now to urge the EPA to grant California's full waiver authority for vehicle emissions? We'll submit it directly to decision-makers._**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/sign-on-ca_cleaner_trucks_comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&t=5&akid=13084%2E53494%2E8BHu-Z)
[SUBMIT A COMMENT](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/sign-on-ca_cleaner_trucks_comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&t=6&akid=13084%2E53494%2E8BHu-Z)
---
The _Clean Air Act_ gives California waiver authority to set its own tailpipe emissions standards, helping to reduce pollution and accelerate the transition to clean vehicles.
**But now, the trucking industry is throwing its weight around, suing the EPA to get the Biden administration to partially deny the waiver.**
Giving in to the trucking industry would be disastrous for President Biden and EPA head Michael Regan, who have pledged to use their authority to fight climate change and support environmental justice communities who suffer the most from tailpipe pollution.
[**_Will you join us in telling EPA to grant California's full vehicle emissions waiver authority? Sign an official public comment right now, and we'll submit it directly to EPA decision-makers._**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/sign-on-ca_cleaner_trucks_comment/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-29_ca_waiver_comment_&t=7&akid=13084%2E53494%2E8BHu-Z)
We don't have to accept the deaths, the missed school days, and the toll these tailpipe emissions take on our health. **Every other Democratic administration in this position has approved California's vehicle emissions waiver in full—and it's time for the Biden administration to do the same.**
Thanks,
Rachel Patterson
Policy Lead, Evergreen Action
