I'll never forget visiting her at the hospital when we were kids, seeing oxygen tubes in her nose and a machine helping her stay alive. Tailpipe emissions cause thousands of Americans to suffer this way. That's why we're urging the EPA to grant California's full waiver authority to reduce deadly tailpipe pollution and pave the way for other states to do the same. The Clean Air Act gives California waiver authority to set its own tailpipe emissions standards, helping to reduce pollution and accelerate the transition to clean vehicles. But now, the trucking industry is throwing its weight around, suing the EPA to get the Biden administration to partially deny the waiver. Giving in to the trucking industry would be disastrous for President Biden and EPA head Michael Regan, who have pledged to use their authority to fight climate change and support environmental justice communities who suffer the most from tailpipe pollution. We don't have to accept the deaths, the missed school days, and the toll these tailpipe emissions take on our health. Every other Democratic administration in this position has approved California's vehicle emissions waiver in full—and it's time for the Biden administration to do the same. Thanks, Rachel Patterson Policy Lead, Evergreen Action

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f6ddda09eea04ba581305981779094d5&_e=TdYtYYA5HaDLOS8ewQqU6lQBe1LEt3rwc2WL6Yuycnmw3tBwZp51lcqMH1PIA2YxO_9zIMU-znEQVzK16cbDBO-2kVBobyi9XG98lqOlQl8IQXNZyuhTL7MuOwfCqvheVKEWffPkhsX0FjZJ6wMi1f64684GS6S50KPz5l3BNQL1lVPT6SdxFwQ8qqCeZ_lIRqgoZgACKqWTdnqX2wQ8So7eg2aEB_BGyTxj1vqgMExTc-MnszRVMdGCTmpFGPzNZydH-aznhuMq3APkNol6r01Hw5FQIGkjullygfEkxZTQ0ylZDJ224ev7YUQcnL-Rr2LqhI2pG9LxAAYqK1xnPd0h9YN_1Oq46LiwYTqq06c%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f6ddda09eea04ba581305981779094d5&_e=TdYtYYA5HaDLOS8ewQqU6lQBe1LEt3rwc2WL6Yuycnmw3tBwZp51lcqMH1PIA2YxO_9zIMU-znEQVzK16cbDBO-2kVBobyi9XG98lqOlQl8IQXNZyuhTL7MuOwfCqvheVKEWffPkhsX0FjZJ6wMi1WLIBW7XiycfdZ2hY5XoxZssuSrS62zv6AqDs08ognWu8X7i0PEUx8bhW3y2q6X5XW5kOEbfQj_NF-AOsfy-9b58NruLXLBe0AXYhsYc8H3L2bHanbZcPKb1nCYJPHh3eM1QjnO2JUknSzvILX85Y7yFOlgPmmoeqk9Jig7PuD0SOESLdBzhOyuHOfeSebXakF0rGmyxl8EBvDytOyHHCFI%3D)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f6ddda09eea04ba581305981779094d5&_e=TdYtYYA5HaDLOS8ewQqU6lQBe1LEt3rwc2WL6Yuycnmw3tBwZp51lcqMH1PIA2YxO_9zIMU-znEQVzK16cbDBO-2kVBobyi9XG98lqOlQl8IQXNZyuhTL7MuOwfCqvheVKEWffPkhsX0FjZJ6wMi1Qz57XNoPqLyqTSf1dsCemyC-DjkPjWYdSHhntvIvpmBLnvcQo-q6G2u68Yx4y8d6QysbvsGrV4dVl-efEw1FMv4jrPIXhvp7xd-PyVV7wgrnP6GiPhxCAvo0M3x7GF2i_JbJyTYy0b1B50lxPMb9EGnPbYMANZI6StwiYNScFDi4X4_wK8ArRKtJxu8IpF4BehiEh-cRyq-0wQgAAoGmf4%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f6ddda09eea04ba581305981779094d5&_e=TdYtYYA5HaDLOS8ewQqU6lQBe1LEt3rwc2WL6Yuycnmw3tBwZp51lcqMH1PIA2YxO_9zIMU-znEQVzK16cbDBO-2kVBobyi9XG98lqOlQl8IQXNZyuhTL7MuOwfCqvheVKEWffPkhsX0FjZJ6wMi1TaGxKsvbQL6Tyrb6cnrGmDuj2KTvCTjJBRtM95ymRLGwfRBrSD5cdGQ30iu9l5qvbjmX1iLm2qdfAcS7UEKCfFW4YCLBvMBScqxy4JvZ_wWsyMHZwBh2fsLtVxVGFDOAY4u5lIsHf7SN_AE0aRMMdV7xZVdJPYSG2lTNZHzL0YYiS_FU22VuAFRUYF095wp9t87WqnR5p-RoR90bK2PBgk%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

| | **This Week on the Campaign Trail** Wow! What an incredible week of connecting with voters throughout the tenth district! The news of a new recession is certainly a cause for concern, but our campaign for common-sense is reason for optimism. Many of us are feeling stuck. We feel weak, and we are losing hope that our children and our grandchildren will not experience the same promise and opportunity of this great nation.The solution lies within the spirit of the American people. We need a government that lifts us up on its shoulders, not rides on our backs. We need to let Americans be Americans. And that starts now, with your support! On Wednesday we hosted an education roundtable discussion with parents. I’m confident that we can ensure quality education for all of our children by empowering parents to play an elevated role in their children’s learning. As your Congressman, I will always advocate for the educational freedom of Virginia families in the tenth.

We need new representation in the tenth that is always interacting with voters and actually enjoys it! I’m ready to be the Representative for you.

clean_body: | | | | | July 29th 2022 | WEEKLY NEWSLETTER | Issue 6 | | This Week on the Campaign Trail Wow! What an incredible week of connecting with voters throughout the tenth district! The news of a new recession is certainly a cause for concern, but our campaign for common-sense is reason for optimism. Many of us are feeling stuck. We feel weak, and we are losing hope that our children and our grandchildren will not experience the same promise and opportunity of this great nation.The solution lies within the spirit of the American people. We need a government that lifts us up on its shoulders, not rides on our backs. We need to let Americans be Americans. And that starts now, with your support! On Wednesday we hosted an education roundtable discussion with parents. I’m confident that we can ensure quality education for all of our children by empowering parents to play an elevated role in their children’s learning. As your Congressman, I will always advocate for the educational freedom of Virginia families in the tenth. I was honored to be invited to speak with activists at the Prince William County Patriots Pub. Their dedication to our values and active participation are critical to securing a win in November! On Tuesday night, we had an unbelievable turnout at our event in Manassas. People from all over the district joined us and we even had some guests all the way from California! We need new representation in the tenth that is always interacting with voters and actually enjoys it! I’m ready to be the Representative for you. Over the weekend, I attended the Loudoun County Farmers Market. There truly is nothing better than striking up conversations with voters out in the community. It was a pleasure to support the farmers market and introduce myself to many new faces. | Join Us Join me this Saturday, July 30th at the Victims of Communism Foundation Event entitled “Red China's Soft War Against America" By Dr. Lee Edwards. RSVP here: August 2nd is the annual National Night Out, a community-police awareness-raising event through the country, held the first Tuesday of August. Invitations will be sent out shortly for our August 4th Fundraiser with Governor Youngkin. We are door knocking in every county this Saturday and all Saturdays leading up to the election. It is imperative that people talk to their neighbors about Hung. We need turnout in November. Email mailto:julia@hungcaoforcongress.com to join us at the doors! | Store We will not be placing a large order of hats or shirts until closer to the election. Date: Wednesday, July 26, 2022 at 3:31 PM
Subject: Mike Flood doesn’t get a say in who I love.
To: Team Patty <dpwillis67@gmail.com>
Friend, I’m Taylor Pansing Brooks — Patty’s son and a proud LGBTQ+ Nebraskan.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48510910/358520078/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220729_fwdfromtaylor_rsnd&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220729_fwdfromtaylor_rsnd&refcode2=ca1bf367-810f-ed11-b47a-281878b82c0f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTFiZjM2Ny04MTBmLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fERH6M-C76J8jmoUpbC8lBBNmDlqgi-QtuVtNgvNXHM=)
I wanted to reach out because frankly, it’s **unconscionable** that our legislators continue to vote against what _should_ be our most fundamental human right: _The right to love whomever we love._
Nebraska hasn’t always been kind to our LGBTQ+ neighbors, and I’m grateful every day that I grew up in a family that has loved and accepted me every moment of every day, without reservation.
Over the last eight years, my mom has fought fiercely on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature for people like me to live and love without fear of discrimination — at work, in our communities, and in the privacy of our homes. She knows that being gay, or bi, or trans, or gender nonconforming, isn’t a _choice_ — **it’s simply who we are.**
The _choice_ lies in whether we come out as our true and authentic selves, or if we continue to suppress the most inextricable parts of our identity because it makes some of our elected officials uncomfortable. **People like Mike Flood are voting to keep us in the shadows. I say it’s time to rise up and vote him out of office this November.**

Exciting news from the campaign trail today! Former U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon announced today that he | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f431f2dd3636/team-tanya-alert-former-senator-jon-kyl-endorses-tanya-wheeless-7245241?e=bd2b55b0e3)

---
| | | Hi Friend, Exciting news from the campaign trail today! Former U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon announced today that he voted for Tanya in the Republican primary for Arizona’s 4th Congressional District.

_“As a U.S. Congressman, I represented most of Arizona’s new 4th Congressional District and that’s why it is very important to me that the person who wins this primary will have my former constituents’ best interests at heart and fight for them every day in Congress. I decided to vote for Tanya Contreras Wheeless because I know she will do just that.”_ **said Former U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon.**

_“Tanya has already shown that she can weather attacks from Democrats and rise above them. She is the only one who can beat Democrat incumbent Greg Stanton. That’s why the Democrats are already attacking her and why this primary is so important. I encourage others to join me in voting for Tanya Contreras Wheeless. She is my pick to carry on the tradition of conservative leadership in the East Valley.”_
[**Join Former U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon in Supporting Tanya by Liking and Sharing His Pick in AZ-04!**](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=26b41f7731&e=bd2b55b0e3)

---
| We are poised to finish strong and thank you for all of your support!

Best,
Team Tanya
---
| \--
More about Tanya:

**_Tanya Contreras Wheeless_** launched her campaign for U.S. Congress in August 2021. She is a proven leader with a track record of bringing people together to solve problems. Her vast professional experience includes lawyer, business association CEO, sports executive with the Phoenix Suns, small business owner, and community advocate.

A valley native, she was born to teen parents and is the granddaughter of immigrants. She grew up in a working-class family that often struggled, but despite the challenges, she learned the importance of faith, family, hard work, and personal responsibility.

Driven by her desire to create a better life for herself, Tanya worked from the time she was 14. She put herself through Arizona State University, becoming the first person in her family to graduate from college. She went on to graduate from ASU Law with distinction, earning a job at one of the nation’s top law firms.

Now, Tanya is ready to bring her experience and thoughtful leadership to Congress. She believes in the promise of the American dream and will fight to preserve it. She will embrace policies that empower people, not the government. And, she will always put Arizona first.

Tanya lives in Tempe with her husband Steve, an attorney and former F-16 pilot in the U.S. Air Force. They have three wonderful children and two dogs who keep them on their toes.

body:
What’s consistent about now and when I first ran for Congress? The why.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=733%2E61531%2Ecem4v0)
Team, my first run for U.S. Congress in 2006 feels like it was both yesterday and a lifetime ago. Check out some rarely-seen photos from the archives:
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3640?t=3&akid=733%2E61531%2Ecem4v0)[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3640?t=4&akid=733%2E61531%2Ecem4v0)
Times have changed, but the reason I ran for Congress and am now running for Senate is the same. I remain in this fight because I’m committed to helping working- and middle-class families across Vermont and the country, and we’ve got much more work to do.
My primary election is just over a week away, and winning next Tuesday would be a major step towards becoming Vermont’s next Senator and holding on to the Democratic majority. [**Sunday is the final end-of-month deadline before the primary. Can you donate $5 to help build on our momentum heading into August?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3640?t=5&akid=733%2E61531%2Ecem4v0)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

Since heading to Congress, I’ve been in the thick of many fights, and I’ve experienced my share of ups and downs—but that’s never stopped me from working to deliver real, progressive solutions for Vermonters. I’m proud to be known as someone who gets things done, because that’s the mindset I’d bring to a Senate too often mired in gridlock.
I remember when Mitch McConnell explicitly said his job was to undercut any and everything President Obama proposed, and lo and behold: He’s running back that same playbook with President Biden in 2022. He’s causing enough damage to our country and our democracy as the Minority Leader—we simply can’t let him get the gavel back. He wants to flip Vermont’s Senate seat, but together we're not going to let that happen, and I hope you’re with me.
The first step toward winning in November and keeping the Senate blue is winning the August 9 primary—and we’ve got to hit our July fundraising goals if we’re going to reach as many voters as possible. [**Please, make a $5 contribution or anything you can give ahead of Sunday’s end-of-month deadline.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3640?t=9&akid=733%2E61531%2Ecem4v0)
Thanks again for all you do,
Peter

| | | | | Peter, Let me make a direct ask up front: [Please subscribe to my rapidly growing Youtube Channel](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6c90cefa-43e7-40af-9cf8-645c98796863/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), **_[The Takedown w Cliff Schecter](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3df2e180-51b5-494c-9a5e-505e71b1c017/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** , where we expose the danger posed to our democracy by Republicans, help Democrats with messaging ideas and call out the failures of our mainstream media to hold Republicans to account. **It's only been 2.5 months since I started the channel and we're well past 4,000 subscriptions. We're quickly approaching our goal of 5000 by Aug 1, __[but I need you to subscribe to get there](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3959fbe6-11d2-489d-8135-ae4df57c4c9c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)__! It’s important, because with 5000 subscribers, YouTube will start recommending The Takedown to other viewers they think would be interested. So ... ** [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1b222dd2-eed8-40ee-9ff2-3476345ef90e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Recently, Takedown vidoes have included Samuel Alito's angry response to criticism from world leaders over his decision to rip rights away from women they've possessed for 50 years, while highlighting how his emotional maturity doesn't approach that of 12 yr old Addison Gardner, who eloquently talked about what Alito and the rest of the right-wingers on that court were doing to her and would do to her body if she were raped. We've also laughed at Trump as the RNC threatens to stop paying the "billionaire's" legal bills if he announces for President.

We’ve exposed the assault rifle makers who have profited to the tune of $1 billion dollars from mass shootings and a marketing campaign to young, white supremacist males who may become future mass shooters. These were only three videos, or one day of content at The Takedown. [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tabb2b8af-1c91-4f27-a5cc-96861be37c04/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We do our best to send you emails to financially support our best candidates and defeat the worst of the authoritarian Republicans. But I felt a need to do more. So I started the Youtube channel[ where I do regular hard-hitting, yet humor-infused commentaries](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0f3dae15-5fb1-4a1e-b76e-9f4b26fee9d1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) on insane Republicans and inane GOP policy every day. I have spent years writing campaign messages and doing communications from the state legislative up to the presidential level. I therefore felt it was a duty of mine at this perilous moment in history to put these skills to their best use possible: Defending democracy. [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T330443b1-9cef-462d-a0e2-071503062e3f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **A subscription to ["The Takedown w/ Cliff Schecter"](https://default.salsalabs.org/T650b9b63-0cb0-486a-80c6-1f36d0b335c6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) on Youtube is** **_100% free_**. And it just takes a few minutes of your time to sign up, and a few more to watch the videos we produce. If you enjoy them, as I think and hope you will, please like them, leave a comment and share them with everyone you know who may be interested. We have won fights with fascism before, and I am confident we can do it again. So before wishing you a good Friday evening, and a great weekend, **I'll ask you one more time if you'd please subscribe to [The Takedown w/ Cliff Schecter](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4a1491fb-5f6d-428a-a2a4-8904d9a1d2f1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). We are closing in on 5,000 subscriptions, and yours could be the one to put us over the top. ** Thank you so much for all you do here and everywhere to fight for our democracy. Please have a wonderful night and fantastic weekend. All my best, Cliff

_**Voting rights**_

I'm sure you've heard that Republicans like Ron DeSantis and Greg Abbott have signed laws restricting the freedom to vote. America is in a [recession.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7abea9b4d6144979966a97254b359974&_e=y4DHMgYlBXLxfGSKqApIjwLvQR83y14T11Kf712rSZziyyRadFDsCuzJWJmoEO2D1-90hGeF9KUcoi1HdBoI3g4PXaPrdfkODsUY-xftSZLuiW9JowVt47CAQMiJLMgBnVvPz2E24pXN9iN5cWi8jMaIDfUxjpcNUiwQ8umY6Tdb4sc66DWkboDx-q_YxGSPbf_c8RVKzmcfNm6TJKxRBbiMgMHWEB8dRLe8auULH55qxMfRhjTSu-cCZRhA10f-fy2hc3QG9bEIMKNwixIAKyEB7WwqEwgu6M1gyH9-L0OnRlvG5pncJ5hmLnCKv4Xb) The latest [GDP numbers](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7abea9b4d6144979966a97254b359974&_e=y4DHMgYlBXLxfGSKqApIjx2cAsA9Z0caoDahHSp75lfzqkv10Bo9gTOJV6fhg8GsFOghsOME4Nlc4ZnJccQzhUyWcjcdLSu3NnOa06q2aeMGb3IyDxBkOdKzGZTdGUIGh7xkbzLbzcrie5vXxqOpXqGnx3S_t1Ii9dT3jiS3ADiIg84tztf_-LbrAsP1i5huCL4Nl2wA8J7jpmzfShMXYHs2JbJ228J7oibfj7EVZGU2rKCvnYbylqViZhnw8BV1CbI3bjViEl8pqehBzO7g8_WbXA5nCjwbVXiFQFkt1fDvjHrVytUcGRRzay5ldpmg) show that our economy shrunk for the second quarter in a row. That’s the definition of a recession._ _ My Republican colleagues and I warned this was coming for a long time. _ _ So what’s Biden’s solution to his man-made economic disaster? _ _ Tying himself in knots to change the definition of recession... _ _ The Biden administration, along with the liberal media, have been trying their best to [spin](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7abea9b4d6144979966a97254b359974&_e=y4DHMgYlBXLxfGSKqApIjy6tRB4WurNJX0vaDy_WnEgvyQqafDQ8a2mj-KB3VwohvC4mj9qGuzrj9ggjQiTXB8FahLXBOeGClp5otieacdvwZ4pv4IV-r3krLg7s0oS2RHKTVT1xwMR8Q1O_TxtpuEuUqTt-Irs9J-11B4e1-S4vSbvk3uxK-P33tWd01cuKN3gARj-tXZ7G4n7oIVBbo5AlU87xENnG2CFSvjDofYb43cgCEAMXQQtstS0JABQkoLlYi5twUQez5aAeEHFvJ_pbY36YgWNBtgME_FWyGKI_T1T6GIw20ZVH3Z9q6FfwgW12qpxwqOQlf6_9yjnebuhUOhUPY-eXUmz4VDbMtl95n0kCMbxADEYfPpsSSouj) the latest economic numbers with smoke and mirrors. Some are even flat-out [denying](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=7abea9b4d6144979966a97254b359974&_e=y4DHMgYlBXLxfGSKqApIj0NAfDbvaINt8hl0FqLNy5O1B67ir5lUKnv1FZ5jhA6y59iX32RR5zsrDV3lNK4gih_SITyAkOnFkR0KajQGc_JKzHpJ-38OZGq-Us8ADi13RNOrA0_VW71GXEr0KOgccew9SMKGY1RQDDXcxWWWFyN6INLu7_kEQrNZIukHgIKGM3KA-fWCbJhE2d3ZXh-jTNNKCzWFO2ztHdG9XozdW_LKNIWmU2M3HaR6CeJ9kLFl7pH12l7iZTJ0s19Nng7pxxoBhACfg23r2WFqX5Rmx0PTihNc8gt7iOGCBJCaw5pJDTeJ2vxM__zYHxJjGoIM6MbojdyzK7UxOfa6yq7Sj6I%3D) that we are in a recession. body:
I grew up in PA and I’m raising my family here. My opponent can’t say the same.
#
Derek, wanna know what’s a really weird sensation?
**The feeling of watching your Republican opponent for U.S. Senate play tourist in the town you grew up in. 🙄**
I mean, it was actually kind of hilarious to see Dr. Oz on the campaign trail in my hometown of York, PA earlier this week. He took a photo at New Eastern Market which is a *classic* York landmark.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220729-2?refcode=em20220729-6689&refcode2=6689_434096_MR3TpC&akid=6689%2E434096%2EMR3TpC)
_It’s not every day a REAL New Jersey 🤩 Celebrity Doctor comes to York, PA!_
New Eastern Market has been operating since the late 1880s, and my parents have been shopping there for as long as I can remember. In fact, they’ve lived in the same house (about three miles from New Eastern Market) since 1975.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220729-2?refcode=em20220729-6689&refcode2=6689_434096_MR3TpC&akid=6689%2E434096%2EMR3TpC)
_Dad + Me in the 1970s_
We had a family routine: After New Eastern, my brother Gregg and I would pester Mom to take us to the Hills for a new Lego kit (KiddyTown had the best selection, tbh). I can still smell the popcorn 🍿 in the lobby.
NOTHING beats summer in York when you’re a kid! In the 1980s, Gregg and I would spend countless hours at Avalon's Golf at the York Mall. They had Donkey Kong in the arcade which, of course, is in the pantheon of video games. 😎
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220729-2?refcode=em20220729-6689&refcode2=6689_434096_MR3TpC&akid=6689%2E434096%2EMR3TpC)
_Mom + Me in the 1980s, wearing my favorite Pyromania Def Leppard shirt._
I ❤️ York, PA and it will always have a place in my heart.
I’m grateful that York is where my parents decided to raise their family when they were just starting out on their own. And I’m grateful that Gisele and I are raising our family in Braddock, PA so they can experience the York memories of my childhood, too.
**Dr. Oz, on the other hand, didn’t grow up in PA, doesn’t live in PA, and didn’t raise his family in PA.**
I mean, he literally voted in New Jersey as recently as 2020. Seriously???!!!

clean_body: I grew up in PA and I’m raising my family here. My opponent can’t say the same. Derek, wanna know what’s a really weird sensation? The feeling of watching your Republican opponent for U.S. Senate play tourist in the town you grew up in. 🙄 I mean, it was actually kind of hilarious to see Dr. Oz on the campaign trail in my hometown of York, PA earlier this week. He took a photo at New Eastern Market which is a classic York landmark. It’s not every day a REAL New Jersey 🤩 Celebrity Doctor comes to York, PA! New Eastern Market has been operating since the late 1880s, and my parents have been shopping there for as long as I can remember. In fact, they’ve lived in the same house (about three miles from New Eastern Market) since 1975. Dad + Me in the 1970s We had a family routine: After New Eastern, my brother Gregg and I would pester Mom to take us to the Hills for a new Lego kit (KiddyTown had the best selection, tbh). I can still smell the popcorn 🍿 in the lobby. NOTHING beats summer in York when you’re a kid! In the 1980s, Gregg and I would spend countless hours at Avalon's Golf at the York Mall. They had Donkey Kong in the arcade which, of course, is in the pantheon of video games. 😎 Mom + Me in the 1980s, wearing my favorite Pyromania Def Leppard shirt. I ❤️ York, PA and it will always have a place in my heart. I’m grateful that York is where my parents decided to raise their family when they were just starting out on their own. And I’m grateful that Gisele and I are raising our family in Braddock, PA so they can experience the York memories of my childhood, too. Dr. Oz, on the other hand, didn’t grow up in PA, doesn’t live in PA, and didn’t raise his family in PA. I mean, he literally voted in New Jersey as recently as 2020. Seriously???!!! Derek, hopefully now you can understand why seeing Dr. Oz in my hometown is actually kind of hilarious. This guy is just so out of touch. **__****_This is an important message for:_** The violent crime rate has risen in 6 major U.S. cities-all of which are run by Democrats who have turned their backs on our police forces. Even in Wisconsin, **[violent crime is on the rise.](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=5bXETH0hUIJfA4WfEqiDLoaZEhi9ZHMYqQyeylBwj4GvW1x3ObPq92XnVmw3O6ifloki78a6JNdf34b7ZYQqd5NDu-XmIusSjrugUBNtia0XkyJQt1qy8AsyrxNpWN7W&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=crimespree_1&n=1)** **Our elected officials need to be strong on crime and respect heroic officers in order to keep our communities safe.
